brahmā provāca tataḥ prajāpatir adhijage tasmād aśvinau aśvibhyām indraḥ indrād ahaṃ mayā tv iha pradeyam arthibhyaḥ prajāhitahetoḥ tataḥ+prajāpatir · upanayanīyaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ praśasteṣu tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatreṣu praśastāyāṃ diśi śucau same deśe caturhastaṃ caturasraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipya gomayena darbhaiḥ saṃstīrya puṣpair lājabhaktai ratnaiś ca devatāḥ pūjayitvā viprān bhiṣajaś ca tatrollikhyābhyukṣya ca dakṣiṇato brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayitvāgnim upasamādhāya khadirapalāśadevadārubilvānāṃ samidbhiś caturṇāṃ vā kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ dadhimadhughṛtāktābhir dārvīhaumikena vidhinā sruveṇājyāhutīr juhuyāt sapraṇavābhir mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ tataḥ pratidaivatam ṛṣīṃś ca svāhākāraṃ kuryāt śiṣyam api kārayet tataḥ+pratidaivatam · tato 'gniṃ triḥ pariṇīyāgnisākṣikaṃ śiṣyaṃ brūyāt kāmakrodhalobhamohamānāhaṃkārerṣyāpāruṣyapaiśunyānṛtālasyāyaśasyāni hitvā nīcanakharomṇā śucinā kaṣāyavāsasā satyavratabrahmacaryābhivādanatatpareṇāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ madanumatasthānagamanaśayanāsanabhojanādhyayanapareṇa bhūtvā matpriyahiteṣu vartitavyam ato 'nyathā te vartamānasyādharmo bhavati aphalā ca vidyā na ca prākāśyaṃ prāpnoti triḥ+pariṇīya · athātaḥ prabhāṣaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athātaḥ +prabhāṣaṇīyam

tasmin kriyā so 'dhiṣṭhānaṃ kasmāt lokasya dvaividhyāt loko hi dvividhaḥ sthāvaro jaṅgamaś ca dvividhātmaka evāgneyaḥ saumyaś ca tadbhūyastvāt pañcātmako vā tatra caturvidho bhūtagrāmaḥ saṃsvedajarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasaṃjñaḥ tatra puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ tasyopakaraṇamanyat tasmāt puruṣo 'dhiṣṭhānam loko+hi · kālo hi nāma bhagavān svayambhur anādimadhyanidhano 'tra rasavyāpatsampattī jīvitamaraṇe ca manuṣyāṇām āyatte kālo+hi · tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaś ca prasannāḥ snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyaś ca tā upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvādbhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ dehināmavidagdhāḥ snehācchaityādgauravād upalepāc ca śleṣmasaṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayo vasante 'rkaraśmipravilāyita īṣatstabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīn janayati balavatyo+hemante · tatra paittikānāṃ vyādhīnām upaśamo hemante ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ nidāghe vātikānāṃ śaradi svabhāvata eva ta ete saṃcayaprakopopaśamā vyākhyātāḥ upaśamo+hemante

tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaś ca prasannāḥ snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyaś ca tā upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvādbhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ dehināmavidagdhāḥ snehācchaityādgauravād upalepāc ca śleṣmasaṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayo vasante 'rkaraśmipravilāyita īṣatstabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīn janayati upayujyamānā+manda · kokilāṣaṭpadagaṇair upagītā manoharāḥ upagītā+manoharāḥ · bhrāntacakrāhvayugalāḥ payaḥpānākulā mṛgāḥ ākulāḥ→payaḥpānākulā +mṛgāḥ · tatra pippalyajāśakṛdgodantaśaraśalākās tvaggatānāṃ jāmbavauṣṭhetaralauhā māṃsagatānāṃ kṣaudraguḍasnehāḥ sirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthigatānām lauhāḥ→jāmbavauṣṭhetaralauhā +māṃsa

tatra laghvakṣaroccāraṇamātro 'kṣinimeṣaḥ pañcadaśākṣinimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhā triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalā viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ kalādaśabhāgaś ca triṃśanmuhūrtam ahorātraṃ pañcadaśāhorātrāṇi pakṣaḥ sa ca dvividhaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaś ca tau māsaḥ triṃśat+muhūrtam→triṃśanmuhūrtam · daṃśe todakaṇḍuprādurbhāvair jānīyācchuddhamiyamādatta iti śuddhamādadānāmapanayet atha śoṇitagandhena na muñcenmukhamasyāḥ saindhavacūrṇenāvakiret muñcet+mukham→muñcenmukhamasyāḥ · rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedaḥ prajāyate māṃsāt+medaḥ→māṃsānmedaḥ · tatra ṛjvasaṃkīrṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ samam anavagāḍham anuttānamāśu ca śastraṃ pātayenmarmasirāsnāyusaṃdhīnāṃ cānupaghāti pātayet+marma→pātayenmarmasirāsnāyusaṃdhīnāṃ

rasāyanatantraṃ nāma vayaḥsthāpanam āyurmedhābalakaraṃ rogāpaharaṇasamarthaṃ ca vayas+sthāpanam→vayaḥsthāpanam · tatra māghādayo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ dvimāsikam ṛtuṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍṛtavo bhavanti te śiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣāśaraddhemantāḥ teṣāṃ tapastapasyau śiśiraḥ madhumādhavau vasantaḥ śuciśukrau grīṣmaḥ nabhonabhasyau varṣāḥ iṣorjau śarat sahaḥsahasyau hemanta iti sahas+sahasyau→sahaḥsahasyau · tatra nānāprakārāṇāṃ vyālānāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ mukhair mukhāni yantrāṇāṃ prāyaśaḥ sadṛśāni tasmāt tatsārūpyād āgamād upadeśād anyayantradarśanād yuktitaśca kārayet prāyaśaḥ+sadṛśāni · rasādeva striyā raktaṃ rajaḥsaṃjñaṃ pravartate rajas+saṃjñam→rajaḥsaṃjñaṃ

prajñāṃ te varuṇo rājā samudro nābhimaṇḍalam varuṇo+rājā · vāyurvātyuttaraḥ śīto rajodhūmākulā diśaḥ śīto+rajas · nānauṣadhisamavāyāttridoṣaghnaḥ śuklatvāt saumyaḥ tasya saumyasyāpi sato dahanapacanadāraṇādiśaktiraviruddhā sa khalvāgneyauṣadhiguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt kaṭuka uṣṇastīkṣṇaḥ pācano vilayanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ śoṣaṇaḥ stambhano lekhanaḥ kṛmyāmakaphakuṣṭhaviṣamedasām upahantā puṃstvasya cātisevitaḥ śodhano+ropaṇaḥ · sa yadā bhavatyaccho raktastīkṣṇaḥ picchilaś ca tamādāya mahati vastre parisrāvyetaraṃ vibhajya punaragnāvadhiśrayet acchaḥ→bhavatyaccho +raktaḥ

śalyāṅgamaṅgair aparair upetaṃ prāpto 'smi gāṃ bhūya ihopadeṣṭum aparair+upetaṃ · prakope praśame caiva hetur uktaś cikitsakaiḥ hetur+uktaś · evam etat puruṣo vyādhir auṣadhaṃ kriyākāla iti catuṣṭayaṃ samāsena vyākhyātam tatra puruṣagrahaṇāt tatsambhavadravyasamūho bhūtādir uktas tadaṅgapratyaṅgavikalpāś ca tvaṅmāṃsāsthisirāsnāyuprabhṛtayaḥ vyādhigrahaṇād vātapittakaphaśoṇitasaṃnipātavaiṣamyanimittāḥ sarva eva vyādhayo vyākhyātāḥ oṣadhagrahaṇād dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākānām ādeśaḥ kriyāgrahaṇācchedyādīni snehādīni ca karmāṇi vyākhyātāni kālagrahaṇāt sarvakriyākālānām ādeśaḥ ādiḥ→bhūtādir +uktas · evameṣa doṣāṇāṃ saṃcayaprakopahetur uktaḥ hetuḥ→saṃcayaprakopahetur +uktaḥ

brāhmaṇas trayāṇāṃ varṇānām upanayanaṃ kartum arhati rājanyo dvayasya vaiśyo vaiśyasyaiveti śūdram api kulaguṇasampannaṃ mantravarjam anupanītam adhyāpayed ity eke ity+eke · kṛṣṇe 'ṣṭamī tannidhane 'hanī dve śukle tathāpy evam ahar dvisaṃdhyam api→tathāpy +evam · anyaśāstropapannānāṃ cārthānāmihopanītānām arthavaśāt teṣāṃ tadvidyebhya eva vyākhyānam anuśrotavyaṃ kasmāt na hy ekasmin śāstre śakyaḥ sarvaśāstrāṇām avarodhaḥ kartum hy+ekasmin · śeṣāṇāṃ śalyatantrāṇāṃ mūlāny etāni nirdiśet mūlāny+etāni

agnī rakṣatu te jihvāṃ prāṇān vāyus tathaiva ca tathā+eva→tathaiva · mayaivaṃ kṛtarakṣastvaṃ dīrgham āyur avāpnuhi mayā+evam→mayaivaṃ · tathaiva ca rasān sarvān śrutiścāsyopahanyate tathā+eva→tathaiva · ekaiva tu bhavet pāliḥ sthūlā pṛthvī sthirā ca yā ekā+eva→ekaiva

evam etat puruṣo vyādhir auṣadhaṃ kriyākāla iti catuṣṭayaṃ samāsena vyākhyātam tatra puruṣagrahaṇāt tatsambhavadravyasamūho bhūtādir uktas tadaṅgapratyaṅgavikalpāś ca tvaṅmāṃsāsthisirāsnāyuprabhṛtayaḥ vyādhigrahaṇād vātapittakaphaśoṇitasaṃnipātavaiṣamyanimittāḥ sarva eva vyādhayo vyākhyātāḥ oṣadhagrahaṇād dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākānām ādeśaḥ kriyāgrahaṇācchedyādīni snehādīni ca karmāṇi vyākhyātāni kālagrahaṇāt sarvakriyākālānām ādeśaḥ grahaṇāt→oṣadhagrahaṇād +dravya · tryahād dvyahāc charadgrīṣmavarṣāsv api ca buddhimān ahāt→tryahād +dvi · tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā viśeṣā rogeṣu vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante tatra saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchati ity evamādayaḥ sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ sparśaviśeṣā jvaraśophādiṣu cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayaḥ rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā ariṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ praśnena ca vijānīyāddeśaṃ kālaṃ jātiṃ sātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balamantaragniṃ vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ pravṛttyapravṛttī kālaprakarṣādīṃś ca viśeṣān vijānīyāt+deśam→vijānīyāddeśaṃ · tatra yadvivarṇaṃ pluṣyate 'timātraṃ tat pluṣṭaṃ yatrottiṣṭhanti sphoṭāstīvrāś coṣadāharāgapākavedanāś cirāccopaśāmyanti taddurdagdhaṃ samyagdagdham anavagāḍhaṃ tālaphalavarṇaṃ susaṃsthitaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇayuktaṃ ca atidagdhe māṃsāvalambanaṃ gātraviśleṣaḥ sirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthivyāpādanam atimātraṃ jvaradāhapipāsāmūrchāś copadravā bhavanti vraṇaścāsya cireṇa rohati rūḍhaś ca vivarṇo bhavati tat+durdagdham→taddurdagdhaṃ

tasmāt saviṃśam adhyāyaśatam anupadapādaślokam anuvarṇayitavyam anuśrotavyaṃ ca kasmāt sūkṣmā hi dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākadoṣadhātumalāśayamarmasirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthigarbhasambhavadravyasamūhavibhāgās tathā pranaṣṭaśalyoddharaṇavraṇaviniścayabhagnavikalpāḥ sādhyayāpyapratyākhyeyatā ca vikārāṇām evamādayaścānye sahasraśo viśeṣā ye vicintyamānā vimalavipulabuddher api buddhim ākulīkuryuḥ kiṃ punar alpabuddheḥ tasmād avaśyamanupadapādaślokam anuvarṇayitavyam anuśrotavyaṃ ca viśeṣā+ye · sa yadā bhavatyaccho raktastīkṣṇaḥ picchilaś ca tamādāya mahati vastre parisrāvyetaraṃ vibhajya punaragnāvadhiśrayet sa+yadā · sa yathā nātisāndro nātidravaś ca bhavati tathā prayateta sa+yathā · sa yadā surūḍho nirupadravaḥ savarṇo bhavati tadainaṃ śanaiḥśanair abhivardhayet sa+yadā

bhagavan śārīramānasāgantuvyādhibhir vividhavedanābhighātopadrutān sanāthān apy anāthavad viceṣṭamānān vikrośataś ca mānavānabhisamīkṣya manasi naḥ pīḍā bhavati teṣāṃ sukhaiṣiṇāṃ rogopaśamārthamātmanaś ca prāṇayātrārthaṃ prajāhitahetor āyurvedaṃ śrotum icchāma ihopadiśyamānam atrāyattam aihikam āmuṣmikaṃ ca śreyaḥ tadbhagavantam upapannāḥ smaḥ śiṣyatveneti pīḍā+bhavati · tatra dhārā bhedanānāṃ māsūrī lekhanānām ardhamāsūrī vyadhanānāṃ visrāvaṇānāṃ ca kaiśikī chedanānām ardhakaiśikīti dhārā+bhedanānāṃ · tatra sādhyā api vyādhayaḥ prāyeṇaiṣāṃ duścikitsyatamā bhavanti duścikitsyatamā+bhavanti · tatra yadvivarṇaṃ pluṣyate 'timātraṃ tat pluṣṭaṃ yatrottiṣṭhanti sphoṭāstīvrāś coṣadāharāgapākavedanāś cirāccopaśāmyanti taddurdagdhaṃ samyagdagdham anavagāḍhaṃ tālaphalavarṇaṃ susaṃsthitaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇayuktaṃ ca atidagdhe māṃsāvalambanaṃ gātraviśleṣaḥ sirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthivyāpādanam atimātraṃ jvaradāhapipāsāmūrchāś copadravā bhavanti vraṇaścāsya cireṇa rohati rūḍhaś ca vivarṇo bhavati upadravāḥ→copadravā +bhavanti

nāgāḥ piśācā gandharvāḥ pitaro yakṣarākṣasāḥ piśācā+gandharvāḥ · tvagdoṣā granthayaḥ śophā rogāḥ śoṇitajāśca ye doṣāḥ→tvagdoṣā +granthayaḥ · śophasamutthānā granthividradhyalajīprabhṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa vyādhayo 'bhihitā anekākṛtayaḥ tair vilakṣaṇaḥ pṛthurgrathitaḥ samo viṣamo vā tvaṅmāṃsasthāyī doṣasaṃghātaḥ śarīraikadeśotthitaḥ śopha ityucyate samutthānāḥ→śophasamutthānā +granthi · marmadeśeṣu ye rogā guhyeṣvapi tathā nṝṇām rogā+guhyeṣu

teṣāṃ saṃśodhanasaṃśamanāhārācārāḥ samyakprayuktā nigrahahetavaḥ prayuktāḥ→samyakprayuktā +nigraha · nādhyeyamanyeṣu ca yeṣu viprā nādhīyate nāśucinā ca nityam viprā+na · tatra varṣāsvoṣadhayastaruṇyo 'lpavīryā āpaś cāprasannāḥ kṣitimalaprāyāḥ tā upayujyamānā nabhasi meghāvatate jalapraklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātaviṣṭambhitāgnīnāṃ vidahyante vidāhāt pittasaṃcayamāpādayanti sa saṃcayaḥ śaradi praviralameghe viyaty upaśuṣyati paṅke 'rkakiraṇapravilāyitaḥ paittikān vyādhīn janayati upayujyamānā+nabhasi · ye syurmukhagatā rogā netravartmagatāśca ye rogā+netra

ahaṃ hi dhanvantarirādidevo jarārujāmṛtyuharo 'marāṇām ādidevaḥ→dhanvantarirādidevo +jarā · tasmin kriyā so 'dhiṣṭhānaṃ kasmāt lokasya dvaividhyāt loko hi dvividhaḥ sthāvaro jaṅgamaś ca dvividhātmaka evāgneyaḥ saumyaś ca tadbhūyastvāt pañcātmako vā tatra caturvidho bhūtagrāmaḥ saṃsvedajarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasaṃjñaḥ tatra puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ tasyopakaraṇamanyat tasmāt puruṣo 'dhiṣṭhānam sthāvaro+jaṅgamaś · tatra paśumanuṣyavyālādayo jarāyujāḥ khagasarpasarīsṛpaprabhṛtayo 'ṇḍajāḥ kṛmikīṭapipīlikāprabhṛtayaḥ svedajāḥ indragopamaṇḍūkaprabhṛtaya udbhijjāḥ ādayaḥ→paśumanuṣyavyālādayo +jarāyu · ārtavamaṅgamardamatipravṛttiṃ daurgandhyaṃ ca stanyaṃ stanayor āpīnatvaṃ muhurmuhuḥ pravṛttiṃ todaṃ ca garbho jaṭharābhivṛddhiṃ svedaṃ ca garbho+jaṭhara

tatra nānāprakārāṇāṃ vyālānāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ mukhair mukhāni yantrāṇāṃ prāyaśaḥ sadṛśāni tasmāt tatsārūpyād āgamād upadeśād anyayantradarśanād yuktitaśca kārayet sārūpyāt→tatsārūpyād +āgamād · tatra svastikayantrāṇi aṣṭādaśāṅgulapramāṇāni siṃhavyāghravṛkatarakṣvṛkṣadvīpimārjāraśṛgālamṛgair ivārukakākakaṅkakuraracāsabhāsaśaśaghātyulūkacilliśyenagṛdhrakrauñcabhṛṅgarājāñjalikarṇāvabhañjananandīmukhamukhāni masūrākṛtibhiḥ kīlair avabaddhāni mūle 'ṅkuśavad āvṛttavāraṅgāṇi asthividaṣṭaśalyoddharaṇārtham upadiśyante vat→'ṅkuśavad +āvṛtta · tatra pracchite tanuvastipaṭalāvanaddhena śṛṅgeṇa śoṇitam avasecayed ācūṣaṇāt sāntardīpayālābvā avasecayed+ācūṣaṇāt · atha patitāṃ taṇḍulakaṇḍanapradigdhagātrīṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktamukhīṃ vāmahastāṅguṣṭhāṅgulībhyāṃ gṛhītapucchāṃ dakṣiṇahastāṅguṣṭhāṅgulibhyāṃ śanaiḥ śanair anulomam anumārjayed ā mukhāt vāmayet tāvadyāvat samyagvāntaliṅgānīti anumārjayed+ā

tatra caturviṃśatiḥ svastikayantrāṇi dve saṃdaṃśayantre dve eva tālayantre viṃśatirnāḍyaḥ aṣṭāviṃśatiḥ śalākāḥ pañcaviṃśatirupayantrāṇi viṃśatiḥ+nāḍyaḥ→viṃśatirnāḍyaḥ · teṣu pṛthulāyatasamobhayapālir nemisaṃdhānakaḥ vṛttāyatasamobhayapālirutpalabhedyakaḥ hrasvavṛttasamobhayapālir vallūrakaḥ abhyantaradīrghaikapālirāsaṅgimaḥ bāhyadīrghaikapālir gaṇḍakarṇaḥ apālirubhayato 'pyāhāryaḥ pīṭhopamapālirubhayataḥ sthūlāṇusamaviṣamapālir vyāyojimaḥ kṣīṇaputrikāśrito abhyantaradīrghaikapāliritarālpapāliḥ nirvedhimaḥ kapāṭasaṃdhikaḥ bāhyadīrghaikapālir itarālpapālir ardhakapāṭasaṃdhikaḥ pāliḥ→pṛthulāyatasamobhayapālir +nemisaṃdhānakaḥ · sa yadā bāhyābhyantaraiḥ kriyāviśeṣair na saṃbhāvitaḥ praśamayituṃ kriyāviparyayādbahutvādvā doṣāṇāṃ tadā pākābhimukho bhavati viśeṣaiḥ→kriyāviśeṣair +na · gacchato vividhair yānair nāsya duṣyati sa vraṇaḥ yānair+na

sa uvācaivam astv iti sa+uvāca · tadduḥkhasaṃyogā vyādhaya ucyante vyādhaya+ucyante · tatra paśumanuṣyavyālādayo jarāyujāḥ khagasarpasarīsṛpaprabhṛtayo 'ṇḍajāḥ kṛmikīṭapipīlikāprabhṛtayaḥ svedajāḥ indragopamaṇḍūkaprabhṛtaya udbhijjāḥ prabhṛtayaḥ→indragopamaṇḍūkaprabhṛtaya +udbhijjāḥ · tatra bhrūgaṇḍaśaṅkhalalāṭākṣipuṭauṣṭhadantaveṣṭakakṣākukṣivaṅkṣaṇeṣu tiryak cheda uktaḥ cheda+uktaḥ

tataḥ śastram avacārya śītābhir adbhir āturam āśvāsya samantāt paripīḍyāṅgulyā vraṇam abhimṛdya prakṣālya kaṣāyeṇa protenodakamādāya tilakalkamadhusarpiḥpragāḍhām auṣadhayuktāṃ nātisnigdhāṃ nātirūkṣāṃ vartiṃ praṇidadhyāt tataḥ kalkenācchādya ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ dattvā vastrapaṭṭena badhnīyāt vedanārakṣoghnair dhūpair dhūpayet rakṣoghnaiś ca mantrai rakṣāṃ kurvīta tataḥ+kalkena · tataḥ kṛtarakṣamāturam āgāraṃ praveśya ācārikam ādiśet tataḥ+kṛta · yantreṣvataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣvadhikāri caiva atas→yantreṣvataḥ +kaṅka · athātaḥ kṣārapākavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athātaḥ +kṣārapākavidhim

ta ūcur bhūyo 'pi bhagavantam asmākam ekamatīnāṃ matam abhisamīkṣya suśruto bhagavantaṃ prakṣyati asmai copadiśyamānaṃ vayam apy upadhārayiṣyāmaḥ ūcur+bhūyo · śrūyate hi yathā rudreṇa yajñasya śiraśchinnamiti tato devā aśvināv abhigamyocur bhagavantau naḥ śreṣṭhatamau yuvāṃ bhaviṣyathaḥ bhavadbhyāṃ yajñasya śiraḥ saṃdhātavyam iti ūcuḥ→abhigamyocur +bhagavantau · mānasāstu krodhaśokabhayaharṣaviṣāderṣyābhyasūyādainyamātsaryakāmalobhaprabhṛtaya icchādveṣabhedair bhavanti bhedaiḥ→icchādveṣabhedair +bhavanti · tatra sthānaparityāgaśāntikarmaprāyaścittamaṅgalajapahomopahārejyāñjalinamaskārataponiyamadayādānadīkṣābhyupagamadevatābrāhmaṇaguruparair bhavitavyam evaṃ sādhu bhavati paraiḥ→sthānaparityāgaśāntikarmaprāyaścittamaṅgalajapahomopahārejyāñjalinamaskārataponiyamadayādānadīkṣābhyupagamadevatābrāhmaṇaguruparair +bhavitavyam

nānauṣadhisamavāyāttridoṣaghnaḥ śuklatvāt saumyaḥ tasya saumyasyāpi sato dahanapacanadāraṇādiśaktiraviruddhā sa khalvāgneyauṣadhiguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt kaṭuka uṣṇastīkṣṇaḥ pācano vilayanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ śoṣaṇaḥ stambhano lekhanaḥ kṛmyāmakaphakuṣṭhaviṣamedasām upahantā puṃstvasya cātisevitaḥ stambhano+lekhanaḥ · kaṭukastatra bhūyiṣṭho lavaṇo 'nurasastathā bhūyiṣṭho+lavaṇo · tatra samyagdagdhe vikāropaśamo lāghavam anāsrāvaś ca upaśamaḥ→vikāropaśamo +lāghavam · utpanne tu śilājatuguggulugomūtratriphalāloharajorasāñjanamadhuyavamudgakoradūṣakaśyāmākoddālakādīnāṃ virūkṣaṇacchedanīyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ vidhivadupayogo vyāyāmo lekhanavastyupayogaś ceti vyāyāmo+lekhanavasti

tāv ūcatur evam astv iti ūcatur+evam · tato dūtanimittaśakunamaṅgalānulomyenāturagṛhamabhigamya upaviśya āturamabhipaśyet spṛśet pṛcchec ca tribhir etair vijñānopāyai rogāḥ prāyaśo veditavyā ity eke tattu na samyak ṣaḍvidho hi rogāṇāṃ vijñānopāyaḥ tadyathā pañcabhiḥ śrotrādibhiḥ praśnena ceti tribhir+etair · tataḥ kṣāradroṇamudakadroṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhir āloḍya mūtrair vā yathoktair ekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ parisrāvya mahati kaṭāhe śanair darvyāvaghaṭṭayan vipacet uktaiḥ→yathoktair +ekaviṃśati · kalpair etaistribhir vaidyaḥ prayateta yathāvidhi kalpair+etaiḥ

ta ete manaḥśarīrādhiṣṭhānāḥ manas+śarīra→manaḥśarīrādhiṣṭhānāḥ · athātaḥ śiṣyopanayanīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athātaḥ +śiṣyopanayanīyam · tataḥ śastram avacārya śītābhir adbhir āturam āśvāsya samantāt paripīḍyāṅgulyā vraṇam abhimṛdya prakṣālya kaṣāyeṇa protenodakamādāya tilakalkamadhusarpiḥpragāḍhām auṣadhayuktāṃ nātisnigdhāṃ nātirūkṣāṃ vartiṃ praṇidadhyāt tataḥ kalkenācchādya ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ dattvā vastrapaṭṭena badhnīyāt vedanārakṣoghnair dhūpair dhūpayet rakṣoghnaiś ca mantrai rakṣāṃ kurvīta tataḥ+śastram · tatra manaḥśarīrābādhakarāṇi śalyāni teṣāmāharaṇopāyo yantrāṇi manas+śarīra→manaḥśarīrābādhakarāṇi

brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānām anyatamam anvayavayaḥśīlaśauryaśaucācāravinayaśaktibalamedhādhṛtismṛtimatipratipattiyuktaṃ tanujihvauṣṭhadantāgramṛjuvaktrākṣināsaṃ prasannacittavākceṣṭaṃ kleśasahaṃ ca bhiṣak śiṣyam upanayet ato viparītaguṇaṃ nopanayet ato+viparīta · tasmāt saviṃśam adhyāyaśatam anupadapādaślokam anuvarṇayitavyam anuśrotavyaṃ ca kasmāt sūkṣmā hi dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākadoṣadhātumalāśayamarmasirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthigarbhasambhavadravyasamūhavibhāgās tathā pranaṣṭaśalyoddharaṇavraṇaviniścayabhagnavikalpāḥ sādhyayāpyapratyākhyeyatā ca vikārāṇām evamādayaścānye sahasraśo viśeṣā ye vicintyamānā vimalavipulabuddher api buddhim ākulīkuryuḥ kiṃ punar alpabuddheḥ tasmād avaśyamanupadapādaślokam anuvarṇayitavyam anuśrotavyaṃ ca sahasraśo+viśeṣā · ato viparītaguṇamādadīta anyatra karapattrāt taddhi kharadhāramasthicchedanārtham ato+viparīta · tato dūtanimittaśakunamaṅgalānulomyenāturagṛhamabhigamya upaviśya āturamabhipaśyet spṛśet pṛcchec ca tribhir etair vijñānopāyai rogāḥ prāyaśo veditavyā ity eke tattu na samyak ṣaḍvidho hi rogāṇāṃ vijñānopāyaḥ tadyathā pañcabhiḥ śrotrādibhiḥ praśnena ceti prāyaśo+veditavyā

ata ūrdhvaṃ doṣakālabalādīnavekṣya kaṣāyālepanabandhāhārācārān vidadhyāt ata+ūrdhvaṃ · ata ūrdhvam avyāpannānām ṛtūnāṃ lakṣaṇānyupadekṣyāmaḥ ata+ūrdhvam · ata ūrdhvamitarathā dagdhalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ata+ūrdhvam · ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhūmopahatalakṣaṇam ata+ūrdhvaṃ

tatra svastikayantrāṇi aṣṭādaśāṅgulapramāṇāni siṃhavyāghravṛkatarakṣvṛkṣadvīpimārjāraśṛgālamṛgair ivārukakākakaṅkakuraracāsabhāsaśaśaghātyulūkacilliśyenagṛdhrakrauñcabhṛṅgarājāñjalikarṇāvabhañjananandīmukhamukhāni masūrākṛtibhiḥ kīlair avabaddhāni mūle 'ṅkuśavad āvṛttavāraṅgāṇi asthividaṣṭaśalyoddharaṇārtham upadiśyante mṛgaiḥ→siṃhavyāghravṛkatarakṣvṛkṣadvīpimārjāraśṛgālamṛgair +iva · mādhuryācchamamāpnoti vahnir adbhir ivāplutaḥ adbhir+iva · sarpirikṣurasaṃ drākṣāṃ payo vā śarkarāmbu vā sarpiḥ+ikṣu→sarpirikṣurasaṃ · teṣu pṛthulāyatasamobhayapālir nemisaṃdhānakaḥ vṛttāyatasamobhayapālirutpalabhedyakaḥ hrasvavṛttasamobhayapālir vallūrakaḥ abhyantaradīrghaikapālirāsaṅgimaḥ bāhyadīrghaikapālir gaṇḍakarṇaḥ apālirubhayato 'pyāhāryaḥ pīṭhopamapālirubhayataḥ sthūlāṇusamaviṣamapālir vyāyojimaḥ kṣīṇaputrikāśrito abhyantaradīrghaikapāliritarālpapāliḥ nirvedhimaḥ kapāṭasaṃdhikaḥ bāhyadīrghaikapālir itarālpapālir ardhakapāṭasaṃdhikaḥ pāliḥ→bāhyadīrghaikapālir +itarā

sarveṣām agnidagdhānām etad ropaṇam uttamam etad+ropaṇam · rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedaḥ prajāyate rasāt+raktam→rasādraktaṃ · rasajaṃ puruṣaṃ vidyād rasaṃ rakṣetprayatnataḥ vidyād+rasaṃ · yasmādraktaṃ vinā doṣair na kadācit prakupyati yasmāt+raktam→yasmādraktaṃ

iha khalv āyurvedo nāmopāṅgam atharvavedasyānutpādya iva prajāḥ ślokaśatasahasram adhyāyasahasraṃ ca kṛtavān svayambhūḥ tato 'lpāyuṣṭvam alpamedhastvaṃ cālokya narāṇāṃ bhūyo 'ṣṭadhā praṇītavān khalv+āyurvedo · vatsa suśruta iha khalv āyurvedaprayojanaṃ vyādhyupasṛṣṭānāṃ vyādhiparimokṣaḥ svasthasya rakṣaṇaṃ ca khalv+āyurveda · prāṇināṃ punarmūlam āhāro balavarṇaujasāṃ ca sa ṣaṭsu raseṣvāyattaḥ rasāḥ punardravyāśrayāḥ dravyāṇi punar oṣadhayaḥ raseṣu+āyattaḥ→raseṣvāyattaḥ · retas tv āpyāyayantv āpo romāṇy oṣadhayas tathā tv+āpyāyayantv

āyur asmin vidyate 'nena vāyur vindatīty āyurvedaḥ vindati+iti→vindatīty · sa sūkṣmām api kalāṃ na līyata iti kālaḥ saṃkalayati kālayati vā bhūtānīti kālaḥ bhūtāni+iti→bhūtānīti · tatra rasagatau dhātuḥ aharahar gacchatītyato rasaḥ gacchati+iti→gacchatītyato · sthirāścipiṭikāvanto rohatīti tamādiśet rohati+iti→rohatīti

yadā ca niviśate 'śvakhuravadānanaṃ kṛtvonnamya ca skandhaṃ tadā jānīyādgṛhṇātīti cārdravastrāvacchannāṃ dhārayet secayecca jānīyāt+gṛhṇāti→jānīyādgṛhṇātīti · jalaukasāṃ ca yo vetti tatsādhyān sa jayedgadān jayet+gadān→jayedgadān · ārtavaṃ śoṇitaṃ tv āgneyam agnīṣomīyatvād garbhasya agnīṣomīyatvād+garbhasya · kliṣṭajihmāpraśastasūcīvyadhād gāḍhataravartitvād doṣasamudāyād apraśastavyadhād vā yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra vartim upahṛtyāśu madhukairaṇḍamūlamañjiṣṭhāyavatilakalkair madhughṛtapragāḍhair ālepayettāvadyāvat surūḍha iti surūḍhaṃ cainaṃ punarvidhyet vidhānaṃ tu pūrvoktameva vyadhāt→kliṣṭajihmāpraśastasūcīvyadhād +gāḍhatara

ato 'nyatamaṃ karma cikīrṣatā vaidyena pūrvam evopakalpayitavyāni yantraśastrakṣārāgniśalākāśṛṅgajalaukālābūjāmbavauṣṭhapicuprotasūtrapattrapaṭṭamadhughṛtavasāpayas tailatarpaṇakaṣāyālepanakalkavyajanaśītoṣṇodakakaṭāhādīni parikarmiṇaś ca snigdhāḥ sthirā balavantaḥ sthirā+balavantaḥ · tayor dakṣiṇaṃ varṣāśaraddhemantāḥ teṣu bhagavān āpyāyate somaḥ amlalavaṇamadhurāś ca rasā balavanto bhavanti uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balam abhivardhate rasā+balavanto · uttaraṃ ca śiśiravasantagrīṣmāḥ teṣu bhagavān āpyāyate 'rkaḥ tiktakaṣāyakaṭukāś ca rasā balavanto bhavanti uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balam apahīyate rasā+balavanto · tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaś ca prasannāḥ snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyaś ca tā upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvādbhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ dehināmavidagdhāḥ snehācchaityādgauravād upalepāc ca śleṣmasaṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayo vasante 'rkaraśmipravilāyita īṣatstabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīn janayati vīryāḥ→pariṇatavīryā +balavatyo

bhagavan śārīramānasāgantuvyādhibhir vividhavedanābhighātopadrutān sanāthān apy anāthavad viceṣṭamānān vikrośataś ca mānavānabhisamīkṣya manasi naḥ pīḍā bhavati teṣāṃ sukhaiṣiṇāṃ rogopaśamārthamātmanaś ca prāṇayātrārthaṃ prajāhitahetor āyurvedaṃ śrotum icchāma ihopadiśyamānam atrāyattam aihikam āmuṣmikaṃ ca śreyaḥ tadbhagavantam upapannāḥ smaḥ śiṣyatveneti hetoḥ→prajāhitahetor +āyurvedaṃ · tataḥ śastram avacārya śītābhir adbhir āturam āśvāsya samantāt paripīḍyāṅgulyā vraṇam abhimṛdya prakṣālya kaṣāyeṇa protenodakamādāya tilakalkamadhusarpiḥpragāḍhām auṣadhayuktāṃ nātisnigdhāṃ nātirūkṣāṃ vartiṃ praṇidadhyāt tataḥ kalkenācchādya ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ dattvā vastrapaṭṭena badhnīyāt vedanārakṣoghnair dhūpair dhūpayet rakṣoghnaiś ca mantrai rakṣāṃ kurvīta adbhir+āturam · tato guggulvagurusarjarasavacāgaurasarṣapacūrṇair lavaṇanimbapattravimiśrair ājyayuktair dhūpayet ājyaśeṣeṇa cāsya prāṇān samālabheta vimiśraiḥ→lavaṇanimbapattravimiśrair +ājya · taṃ cikīrṣuḥ śaradi girisānujaṃ śucirupoṣya praśaste 'hani praśastadeśajātam anupahataṃ madhyamavayasaṃ mahāntam asitamuṣkakam adhivāsyāparedyuḥ pāṭayitvā khaṇḍaśaḥ prakalpyāvapāṭya nirvāte deśe nicitiṃ kṛtvā sudhāśarkarāś ca prakṣipya tilanālair ādīpayet nālaiḥ→tilanālair +ādīpayet

tāstu dvividhāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāś ca sthāvarā+jaṅgamāś · channastuṣāraiḥ savitā himānaddhā jalāśayāḥ ānaddhāḥ→himānaddhā +jalāśayāḥ · tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā viśeṣā rogeṣu vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante tatra saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchati ity evamādayaḥ sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ sparśaviśeṣā jvaraśophādiṣu cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayaḥ rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā ariṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ praśnena ca vijānīyāddeśaṃ kālaṃ jātiṃ sātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balamantaragniṃ vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ pravṛttyapravṛttī kālaprakarṣādīṃś ca viśeṣān viśeṣāḥ→sparśaviśeṣā +jvara · gṛhītāś ca tāḥ sarṣaparajanīkalkodakapradigdhagātrīḥ salilasarakamadhye muhūrtasthitā vigataklamā jñātvā tābhī rogaṃ grāhayet klamāḥ→vigataklamā +jñātvā

kāmāṃste pāntu gandharvāḥ sattvamindro 'bhirakṣatu kāmān+te→kāmāṃste · evaṃ prakupitāḥ tāṃstān śarīrapradeśānāgamya tāṃstān vyādhīn janayanti tān+tān→tāṃstān · evaṃ prakupitāḥ tāṃstān śarīrapradeśānāgamya tāṃstān vyādhīn janayanti tān+tān→tāṃstān · yasmiṃstodādayo deśe suptatā gurutāpi ca yasmin+toda→yasmiṃstodādayo

kṣīṇasya yasya kṣuttṛṣṇe hṛdyair miṣṭair hitaistathā miṣṭair+hitaiḥ · plavaṃ pratitarair hīnaṃ karṇadhāra ivāmbhasi pratitarair+hīnaṃ · ebhir guṇair hīnataraistu kiṃcidvidyādyavebhyo 'tiyavānaśeṣaiḥ guṇair+hīnataraiḥ · susvinno nistuṣo bhṛṣṭa īṣatsūpo laghurhitaḥ laghuḥ+hitaḥ→laghurhitaḥ

tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā viśeṣā rogeṣu vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante tatra saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchati ity evamādayaḥ sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ sparśaviśeṣā jvaraśophādiṣu cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayaḥ rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā ariṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ praśnena ca vijānīyāddeśaṃ kālaṃ jātiṃ sātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balamantaragniṃ vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ pravṛttyapravṛttī kālaprakarṣādīṃś ca viśeṣān rasanā+indriya→rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ · tāsu añjanacūrṇavarṇā pṛthuśirāḥ kṛṣṇā varmimatsyavadāyatā chinnonnatakukṣiḥ karburā romaśā mahāpārśvā kṛṣṇamukhī alagardā indrāyudhavad ūrdhvarājibhiścitritā indrāyudhā īṣadasitapītikā vicitrapuṣpākṛticitrā sāmudrikā govṛṣaṇavadadhobhāge dvidhābhūtākṛtiraṇumukhī gocandaneti gocandanā+iti→gocandaneti · tato 'ṅganāṃ puruṣaṃ vā grathitakeśāntaṃ laghu bhuktavantamāptaiḥ suparigṛhītaṃ ca kṛtvā bandham upadhārya chedyabhedyalekhyavyadhanair upapannair upapādya karṇaśoṇitamavekṣya duṣṭamaduṣṭaṃ veti tatra vātaduṣṭe dhānyāmloṣṇodakābhyāṃ pittaduṣṭe śītodakapayobhyāṃ śleṣmaduṣṭe surāmaṇḍoṣṇodakābhyāṃ prakṣālya karṇau punar avalikhyānunnatam ahīnam aviṣamaṃ ca karṇasaṃdhiṃ saṃniveśya sthitaraktaṃ saṃdadhyāt vā+iti→veti · tatra vā gatigandhanayor iti dhātuḥ tapa saṃtāpe śliṣa āliṅgane eteṣāṃ kṛdvihitaiḥ pratyayair vātaḥ pittaṃ śleṣmeti ca rūpāṇi bhavanti śleṣmā+iti→śleṣmeti

viśeṣeṇa śleṣmajvarapratiśyāyāntarvidradhiṣu apravartamāne vā doṣe pippalīvacāgaurasarṣapakalkonmiśraiḥ salavaṇais tuṣāmbubhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravartayed ā samyagvāntalakṣaṇād iti punaḥ+punaḥ · viśeṣeṇa śleṣmajvarapratiśyāyāntarvidradhiṣu apravartamāne vā doṣe pippalīvacāgaurasarṣapakalkonmiśraiḥ salavaṇais tuṣāmbubhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravartayed ā samyagvāntalakṣaṇād iti punaḥ+pravartayed · gāṅgaṃ punaḥ pradhānaṃ tadupādadītāśvayuje māsi punaḥ+pradhānaṃ · so 'nnaṃ praveśayatyantaḥ prāṇāṃścāpyavalambate antar→praveśayatyantaḥ +prāṇān

svayambhuvā proktamidaṃ sanātanaṃ paṭheddhi yaḥ kāśipatiprakāśitam paṭhet+hi→paṭheddhi · praśastaṃ bhiṣajā jñeyaṃ taddhi karmasu yojayet tat+hi→taddhi · ato viparītaguṇamādadīta anyatra karapattrāt taddhi kharadhāramasthicchedanārtham tat+hi→taddhi · tānyekāntāhitānyeva śeṣaṃ vidyāddhitāhitam vidyāt+hita→vidyāddhitāhitam

sa hovācaivam astv iti sa+ha · tasmāt saviṃśam adhyāyaśatam anupadapādaślokam anuvarṇayitavyam anuśrotavyaṃ ca kasmāt sūkṣmā hi dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākadoṣadhātumalāśayamarmasirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthigarbhasambhavadravyasamūhavibhāgās tathā pranaṣṭaśalyoddharaṇavraṇaviniścayabhagnavikalpāḥ sādhyayāpyapratyākhyeyatā ca vikārāṇām evamādayaścānye sahasraśo viśeṣā ye vicintyamānā vimalavipulabuddher api buddhim ākulīkuryuḥ kiṃ punar alpabuddheḥ tasmād avaśyamanupadapādaślokam anuvarṇayitavyam anuśrotavyaṃ ca sūkṣmā+hi · etā dehe viśeṣeṇa tava nityā hi devatāḥ nityā+hi · na cainaṃ tvaramāṇaḥ sāntardoṣaṃ ropayet sa hy alpenāpy apacāreṇābhyantaram utsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā bhūyo 'pi vikaroti sa+hy

tatra raktapittaprasādakṛdālepaḥ pradeho vātaśleṣmapraśamanaḥ saṃdhānaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ śophavedanāpahaś ca tasyopayogaḥ kṣatākṣateṣu yastu kṣateṣūpayujyate sa bhūyaḥ kalka iti saṃjñāṃ labhate niruddhālepanasaṃjñaḥ tenāsrāvasaṃnirodho mṛdutā pūtimāṃsāpakarṣaṇam anantardoṣatā vraṇaśuddhiś ca bhavati kṣateṣu+upayujyate→kṣateṣūpayujyate · te tūttarāsu gatiṣu bhavanti balavattarāḥ tu+uttarāsu→tūttarāsu · tatra ādyaikavastusaṃniveśī tvagbhedī vraṇaḥ sūpacaraḥ śeṣāḥ svayam avadīryamāṇā durupacārāḥ su+upacaraḥ→sūpacaraḥ · tatra svair aṅgulaiḥ pādāṅguṣṭhapradeśinyau dvyaṅgulāyate pradeśinyāstu madhyamānāmikākaniṣṭhikā yathottaraṃ pañcamabhāgahīnāḥ caturaṅgulāyate pañcāṅgulavistṛte prapadapādatale pañcacaturaṅgulāyatavistṛtā pārṣṇiḥ caturdaśāṅgulāyataḥ pādaḥ caturdaśāṅgulapariṇāhāni pādagulphajaṅghājānumadhyāni aṣṭādaśāṅgulā jaṅghā jānūpariṣṭāc ca dvātriṃśadaṅgulamevaṃ pañcāśat jaṅghāyāmasamāvūrū dvyaṅgulāni vṛṣaṇacibukadaśananāsāpuṭabhāgakarṇamūlanayanāntarāṇi caturaṅgulāni mehanavadanāntaranāsākarṇalalāṭagrīvocchrāyadṛṣṭyantarāṇi dvādaśāṅgulāni bhagavistāramehananābhihṛdayagrīvāstanāntaramukhāyāmamaṇibandhaprakoṣṭhasthaulyāni indravastipariṇāhāṃsapīṭhakūrparāntarāyāmaḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulaḥ caturviṃśatyaṅgulo hastaḥ dvātriṃśadaṅgulaparimāṇau bhujau dvātriṃśatpariṇāhāvūrū maṇibandhakūrparāntaraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulaṃ talaṃ ṣaṭcaturaṅgulāyāmavistāram aṅguṣṭhamūlapradeśinīśravaṇāpāṅgāntaramadhyamāṅgulyau pañcāṅgule ardhapañcāṅgule pradeśinyanāmike sārdhatryaṅgulau kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhau caturviṃśativistārapariṇāhaṃ mukhagrīvaṃ tribhāgāṅgulavistārā nāsāpuṭamaryādā nayanatribhāgapariṇāhā tārakā navamastārakāṃśo dṛṣṭiḥ keśāntamastakāntaramekādaśāṅgulaṃ mastakādavaṭukeśānto daśāṅgulaḥ karṇāvaṭvantaraṃ caturdaśāṅgulaṃ puruṣoraḥpramāṇavistīrṇā strīśroṇiḥ aṣṭādaśāṅgulavistāramuraḥ tatpramāṇā puruṣasya kaṭī saviṃśamaṅgulaśataṃ puruṣāyāma iti jānu+upariṣṭāt→jānūpariṣṭāc

tato 'gniṃ triḥ pariṇīyāgnisākṣikaṃ śiṣyaṃ brūyāt kāmakrodhalobhamohamānāhaṃkārerṣyāpāruṣyapaiśunyānṛtālasyāyaśasyāni hitvā nīcanakharomṇā śucinā kaṣāyavāsasā satyavratabrahmacaryābhivādanatatpareṇāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ madanumatasthānagamanaśayanāsanabhojanādhyayanapareṇa bhūtvā matpriyahiteṣu vartitavyam ato 'nyathā te vartamānasyādharmo bhavati aphalā ca vidyā na ca prākāśyaṃ prāpnoti mad+priya→matpriyahiteṣu · iha tu varṣāśaraddhemantavasantagrīṣmaprāvṛṣaḥ ṣaḍṛtavo bhavanti doṣopacayaprakopopaśamanimittaṃ te tu bhādrapadādyena dvimāsikena vyākhyātāḥ tad yathā bhādrapadāśvayujau varṣāḥ kārttikamārgaśīrṣau śarat pauṣamāghau hemantaḥ phālgunacaitrau vasantaḥ vaiśākhajyeṣṭhau grīṣmaḥ āṣāḍhaśrāvaṇau prāvṛḍ iti śarat+pauṣa · tāni prāyaśo lauhāni bhavanti tatpratirūpakāṇi vā tadalābhe tad+pratirūpakāṇi→tatpratirūpakāṇi · tatrāgnikarma sarvartuṣu kuryādanyatra śaradgrīṣmābhyāṃ tatrāpyātyayike 'gnikarmasādhye vyādhau tatpratyanīkaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā tad+pratyanīkam→tatpratyanīkaṃ

aṣṭāsv api cāyurvedatantreṣv etad evādhikam abhimatam āśukriyākaraṇādyantraśastrakṣārāgnipraṇidhānāt sarvatantrasāmānyāc ca tantreṣu→cāyurvedatantreṣv +etad · eṣyeṣveṣaṇyalābhe tu bālāṅgulyaṅkurā hitāḥ eṣyeṣu+eṣaṇī→eṣyeṣveṣaṇyalābhe · tatra puṣpaphalālābūkālindakatrapusairvārukakarkārukaprabhṛtiṣu chedyaviśeṣān darśayet utkartanaparikartanāni copadiśet dṛtivastiprasevakaprabhṛtiṣūdakapaṅkapūrṇeṣu bhedyayogyāṃ saromṇi carmaṇyātate lekhyasya mṛtapaśusirāsūtpalanāleṣu ca vedhyasya ghuṇopahatakāṣṭhaveṇunalanāḍīśuṣkālābūmukheṣv eṣyasya panasabimbībilvaphalamajjamṛtapaśudanteṣvāhāryasya madhūcchiṣṭopalipte śālmalīphalake visrāvyasya sūkṣmaghanavastrāntayor mṛducarmāntayoś ca sīvyasya pustamayapuruṣāṅgapratyaṅgaviśeṣeṣu bandhanayogyāṃ mṛducarmamāṃsapeśīṣūtpalanāleṣu ca karṇasaṃdhibandhayogyāṃ mṛduṣu māṃsakhaṇḍeṣv agnikṣārayogyām udakapūrṇaghaṭapārśvasrotasyalābūmukhādiṣu ca netrapraṇidhānavastivraṇavastipīḍanayogyām iti mukheṣu→ghuṇopahatakāṣṭhaveṇunalanāḍīśuṣkālābūmukheṣv +eṣyasya · tatra pratisāraṇīyaḥ kuṣṭhakiṭibhadadrumaṇḍalakilāsabhagaṃdarārbudārśoduṣṭavraṇanāḍīcarmakīlatilakālakanyacchavyaṅgamaśakabāhyavidradhikṛmiviṣādiṣūpadiśyate saptasu ca mukharogeṣūpajihvādhijihvopakuśadantavaidarbheṣu tisṛṣu ca rohiṇīṣu eteṣvevānuśastrapraṇidhānam uktam eteṣu+eva→eteṣvevānuśastrapraṇidhānam

upanayanīyaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ praśasteṣu tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatreṣu praśastāyāṃ diśi śucau same deśe caturhastaṃ caturasraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipya gomayena darbhaiḥ saṃstīrya puṣpair lājabhaktai ratnaiś ca devatāḥ pūjayitvā viprān bhiṣajaś ca tatrollikhyābhyukṣya ca dakṣiṇato brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayitvāgnim upasamādhāya khadirapalāśadevadārubilvānāṃ samidbhiś caturṇāṃ vā kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ dadhimadhughṛtāktābhir dārvīhaumikena vidhinā sruveṇājyāhutīr juhuyāt sapraṇavābhir mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ tataḥ pratidaivatam ṛṣīṃś ca svāhākāraṃ kuryāt śiṣyam api kārayet āhutīḥ→sruveṇājyāhutīr +juhuyāt · tatra pūrvāhṇe vasantasya liṅgaṃ madhyāhne grīṣmasya aparāhṇe prāvṛṣaḥ pradoṣe vārṣikaṃ śāradamardharātre pratyuṣasi haimantam upalakṣayet evamahorātram api varṣam iva śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇaṃ doṣopacayaprakopopaśamair jānīyāt upaśamaiḥ→doṣopacayaprakopopaśamair +jānīyāt · ātmasadṛśeṣu vijñānābhyupāyeṣu tatsthānīyair jānīyāt sthānīyaiḥ→tatsthānīyair +jānīyāt · daṃśe todakaṇḍuprādurbhāvair jānīyācchuddhamiyamādatta iti śuddhamādadānāmapanayet atha śoṇitagandhena na muñcenmukhamasyāḥ saindhavacūrṇenāvakiret prādurbhāvaiḥ→todakaṇḍuprādurbhāvair +jānīyāt

evam etat puruṣo vyādhir auṣadhaṃ kriyākāla iti catuṣṭayaṃ samāsena vyākhyātam tatra puruṣagrahaṇāt tatsambhavadravyasamūho bhūtādir uktas tadaṅgapratyaṅgavikalpāś ca tvaṅmāṃsāsthisirāsnāyuprabhṛtayaḥ vyādhigrahaṇād vātapittakaphaśoṇitasaṃnipātavaiṣamyanimittāḥ sarva eva vyādhayo vyākhyātāḥ oṣadhagrahaṇād dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākānām ādeśaḥ kriyāgrahaṇācchedyādīni snehādīni ca karmāṇi vyākhyātāni kālagrahaṇāt sarvakriyākālānām ādeśaḥ tad+sambhava→tatsambhavadravyasamūho · asmin śāstre śastrakarmaprādhānyāc chastrakarma iva tāvat pūrvam upadekṣyāmas tatsambhārāṃś ca tad+sambhārān→tatsambhārāṃś · tatra māghādayo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ dvimāsikam ṛtuṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍṛtavo bhavanti te śiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣāśaraddhemantāḥ teṣāṃ tapastapasyau śiśiraḥ madhumādhavau vasantaḥ śuciśukrau grīṣmaḥ nabhonabhasyau varṣāḥ iṣorjau śarat sahaḥsahasyau hemanta iti śarat+sahas · atha khalvayane dve yugapat saṃvatsaro bhavati te tu pañca yugamiti saṃjñāṃ labhante sa eṣa nimeṣādiryugaparyantaḥ kālaścakravat parivartamānaḥ kālacakram ucyata ity eke yugapat+saṃvatsaro

tad idaṃ śāśvataṃ puṇyaṃ svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ vṛttikaraṃ ceti tad+idaṃ · brāhmaṇas trayāṇāṃ varṇānām upanayanaṃ kartum arhati rājanyo dvayasya vaiśyo vaiśyasyaiveti śūdram api kulaguṇasampannaṃ mantravarjam anupanītam adhyāpayed ity eke adhyāpayed+ity · tāsām upayogādvividharogaprādurbhāvo marako vā bhaved iti bhaved+iti · śoṇitasya ca yogāyogānavekṣya śatadhautaghṛtābhyaṅgas tatpicudhāraṇaṃ vā jalaukovraṇān madhunāvaghaṭṭayet śītābhir adbhiś ca pariṣecayedbadhnīta vā kaṣāyamadhurasnigdhaśītaiś ca pradehaiḥ pradihyāditi pradihyāt+iti→pradihyāditi

tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaś ca prasannāḥ snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyaś ca tā upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvādbhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ dehināmavidagdhāḥ snehācchaityādgauravād upalepāc ca śleṣmasaṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayo vasante 'rkaraśmipravilāyita īṣatstabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīn janayati eva+oṣadhayaḥ→evauṣadhayaḥ · kadācid avyāpanneṣv apy ṛtuṣu kṛtyābhiśāparakṣaḥkrodhādharmair upadhvasyante janapadāḥ viṣauṣadhipuṣpagandhena vāyunopanītenākramyate yo deśastatra doṣaprakṛtyaviśeṣeṇa kāsaśvāsavamathupratiśyāyaśirorugjvarair upatapyante grahanakṣatracaritair vā gṛhadāraśayanāsanayānavāhanamaṇiratnopakaraṇagarhitalakṣaṇanimittaprādurbhāvair vā viṣa+oṣadhi→viṣauṣadhipuṣpagandhena · utpanne tu payasyāśvagandhāvidārigandhāśatāvarībalātibalānāgabalānāṃ madhurāṇāmanyāsāṃ cauṣadhīnām upayogaḥ kṣīradadhighṛtamāṃsaśāliṣaṣṭikayavagodhūmānāṃ ca divāsvapnabrahmacaryāvyāyāmabṛṃhaṇavastyupayogaś ceti ca+oṣadhīnām→cauṣadhīnām · ata ūrdhvamasādhyān vakṣyāmaḥ māṃsapiṇḍavadudgatāḥ prasekino 'ntaḥpūyavedanāvanto 'śvāpānavad udvṛttauṣṭhāḥ kecit kaṭhinā gośṛṅgavad unnatamṛdumāṃsaprarohāḥ apare duṣṭarudhirāsrāviṇas tanuśītapicchilasrāviṇo vā madhyonnatāḥ kecidavasannaśuṣiraparyantāḥ śaṇatūlavat snāyujālavanto durdarśanāḥ vasāmedomajjamastuluṅgasrāviṇaś ca doṣasamutthāḥ pītāsitamūtrapurīṣavātavāhinaś ca koṣṭhasthāḥ ta evobhayatobhāgavraṇamukheṣu pūyaraktanirvāhiṇaḥ kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca sarvatogatayaścāṇumukhā māṃsabudbudavantaḥ saśabdavātavāhinaś ca śiraḥkaṇṭhasthāḥ kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca pūyaraktanirvāhiṇo 'rocakāvipākakāsaśvāsopadravayuktāḥ bhinne vā śiraḥkapāle yatra mastuluṅgadarśanaṃ tridoṣaliṅgaprādurbhāvaḥ kāsaśvāsau vā yasyeti udvṛtta+oṣṭhāḥ→udvṛttauṣṭhāḥ

tān uvāca bhagavān svāgataṃ vaḥ sarva evāmīmāṃsyā adhyāpyāś ca bhavanto vatsāḥ amīmāṃsyāḥ→evāmīmāṃsyā +adhyāpyāś · tā evauṣadhayo nidāghe niḥsārā rūkṣā atimātraṃ laghvyo bhavantyāpaś ca tā upayujyamānāḥ sūryapratāpopaśoṣitadehānāṃ dehināṃ raukṣyāllaghutvādvaiśadyāc ca vāyoḥ saṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayaḥ prāvṛṣi cātyarthaṃ jalopaklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātavarṣerito vātikān vyādhīn janayati rūkṣā+atimātraṃ · tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā viśeṣā rogeṣu vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante tatra saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchati ity evamādayaḥ sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ sparśaviśeṣā jvaraśophādiṣu cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayaḥ rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā ariṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ praśnena ca vijānīyāddeśaṃ kālaṃ jātiṃ sātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balamantaragniṃ vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ pravṛttyapravṛttī kālaprakarṣādīṃś ca viśeṣān vijñeyāḥ→ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā +ariṣṭa · tatra sādhyā api vyādhayaḥ prāyeṇaiṣāṃ duścikitsyatamā bhavanti sādhyā+api

ākāśaṃ khāni te pātu dehaṃ tava vasuṃdharā ākāśaṃ+khāni · śalākāyantrāṇyapi nānāprakārāṇi nānāprayojanāni yathāyogapariṇāhadīrghāṇi ca teṣāṃ gaṇḍūpadasarpaphaṇaśarapuṅkhabaḍiśamukhe dve dve eṣaṇavyūhanacālanāharaṇārtham upadiśyete masūradalamātramukhe dve kiṃcidānatāgre srotogataśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ ṣaṭ kārpāsakṛtoṣṇīṣāṇi pramārjanakriyāsu trīṇi darvyākṛtīni khallamukhāni kṣārauṣadhapraṇidhānārthaṃ trīṇyanyāni jāmbavavadanāni trīṇyaṅkuśavadanāni ṣaḍevāgnikarmasvabhipretāni nāsārbudaharaṇārthamekaṃ kolāsthidalamātramukhaṃ khallatīkṣṇauṣṭham añjanārthamekaṃ kalāyaparimaṇḍalam ubhayato mukulāgraṃ mūtramārgaviśodhanārtham ekaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛntāgrapramāṇaparimaṇḍalam iti mukham→kolāsthidalamātramukhaṃ +khalla · tatra vakraṃ kuṇṭhaṃ khaṇḍaṃ kharadhāram atisthūlam atituccham atidīrgham atihrasvam ityaṣṭau śastradoṣāḥ kuṇṭhaṃ+khaṇḍaṃ · tatra vakraṃ kuṇṭhaṃ khaṇḍaṃ kharadhāram atisthūlam atituccham atidīrgham atihrasvam ityaṣṭau śastradoṣāḥ khaṇḍaṃ+khara

tasya visraṃso vyāpat kṣaya iti liṅgāni vyāpannasya bhavanti saṃdhiviśleṣo gātrāṇāṃ sadanaṃ doṣacyavanaṃ kriyāsaṃnirodhaś ca visraṃse stabdhagurugātratā vātaśopho varṇabhedo glānistandrā nidrā ca vyāpanne mūrchā māṃsakṣayo mohaḥ pralāpo maraṇamiti ca kṣaye vyāpat+kṣaya · ata ūrdhvamasādhyān vakṣyāmaḥ māṃsapiṇḍavadudgatāḥ prasekino 'ntaḥpūyavedanāvanto 'śvāpānavad udvṛttauṣṭhāḥ kecit kaṭhinā gośṛṅgavad unnatamṛdumāṃsaprarohāḥ apare duṣṭarudhirāsrāviṇas tanuśītapicchilasrāviṇo vā madhyonnatāḥ kecidavasannaśuṣiraparyantāḥ śaṇatūlavat snāyujālavanto durdarśanāḥ vasāmedomajjamastuluṅgasrāviṇaś ca doṣasamutthāḥ pītāsitamūtrapurīṣavātavāhinaś ca koṣṭhasthāḥ ta evobhayatobhāgavraṇamukheṣu pūyaraktanirvāhiṇaḥ kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca sarvatogatayaścāṇumukhā māṃsabudbudavantaḥ saśabdavātavāhinaś ca śiraḥkaṇṭhasthāḥ kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca pūyaraktanirvāhiṇo 'rocakāvipākakāsaśvāsopadravayuktāḥ bhinne vā śiraḥkapāle yatra mastuluṅgadarśanaṃ tridoṣaliṅgaprādurbhāvaḥ kāsaśvāsau vā yasyeti kecit+kaṭhinā · kecit kṛśāḥ prāṇavantaḥ sthūlāścālpabalā narāḥ kecit+kṛśāḥ · taikṣṇyauṣṇyalaghutāś caiva na te tatkarmakāriṇaḥ tad+karma→tatkarmakāriṇaḥ

tasya tasya sa lābhe tu taṃ taṃ kṣayamapohati sa+lābhe · saṃcaye 'pahṛtā doṣā labhante nottarā gatīḥ doṣā+labhante · svasthaḥ sa labhate vyādhiṃ vyādhito mṛtyumṛcchati sa+labhate · yūkā lalāṭamāyānti baliṃ nāśnanti vāyasāḥ yūkā+lalāṭam

ojaḥ saṃkṣīyate hy ebhyo dhātugrahaṇaniḥsṛtam ebhyo+dhātu · doṣaḥ prakupito dhātūn kṣapayatyātmatejasā prakupito+dhātūn · syātāṃ vā prasrute yasya sa gatāyurnaro dhruvam naraḥ→gatāyurnaro +dhruvam · saṃkaraḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ praṇāśo dharmakarmaṇām praṇāśo+dharma

sa puṇyakarmā bhuvi pūjito nṛpair asukṣaye śakrasalokatāṃ vrajet sa+puṇya · abhidravanti yaṃ chāyāḥ sa parāsur asaṃśayam sa+parāsur · akasmādyaṃ bhajante vā sa parāsur asaṃśayam sa+parāsur · rujānnavidveṣakarī sa parāsur asaṃśayam sa+parāsur

vāraṇo yuktasenīya āturakramabhūmikau yuktasenīya+ātura · tataḥ kṛtarakṣamāturam āgāraṃ praveśya ācārikam ādiśet praveśya+ācārikam · tatra varṣāsvoṣadhayastaruṇyo 'lpavīryā āpaś cāprasannāḥ kṣitimalaprāyāḥ tā upayujyamānā nabhasi meghāvatate jalapraklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātaviṣṭambhitāgnīnāṃ vidahyante vidāhāt pittasaṃcayamāpādayanti sa saṃcayaḥ śaradi praviralameghe viyaty upaśuṣyati paṅke 'rkakiraṇapravilāyitaḥ paittikān vyādhīn janayati vīryāḥ→'lpavīryā +āpaś · ata ūrdhvam eṣāṃ kṣīṇalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ tatra vātakṣaye mandaceṣṭatālpavāktvamapraharṣo mūḍhasaṃjñatā ca pittakṣaye mandoṣmāgnitā niṣprabhatā ca śleṣmakṣaye rūkṣatāntardāha āmāśayetaraśleṣmāśayaśūnyatā saṃdhiśaithilyaṃ tṛṣṇā daurbalyaṃ prajāgaraṇaṃ ca antardāhaḥ→rūkṣatāntardāha +āmāśaya

tatra visraṃse vyāpanne ca kriyāviśeṣair aviruddhair balamāpyāyayet itaraṃ tu mūḍhasaṃjñaṃ varjayet aviruddhair+balam · sirāsnāyuvilagnaṃ śalākādibhir vimocyāpanayet śvayathugrastavāraṅgaṃ samavapīḍya śvayathuṃ durbalavāraṅgaṃ kuśādibhir baddhvā ādibhiḥ→kuśādibhir +baddhvā · asthivivarapraviṣṭamasthividaṣṭaṃ vāvagṛhya pādābhyāṃ yantreṇāpaharet aśakyamevaṃ vā balavadbhiḥ suparigṛhītasya yantreṇa grāhayitvā śalyavāraṅgaṃ pravibhujya dhanurguṇair baddhvaikataś cāsya pañcāṅgyām upasaṃyatasyāśvasya vaktrakavike badhnīyāt athainaṃ kaśayā tāḍayedyathonnamayan śiro vegena śalyamuddharati dṛḍhāṃ vā vṛkṣaśākhāmavanamya tasyāṃ pūrvavadbaddhvoddharet guṇaiḥ→dhanurguṇair +baddhvā · yasmāt sthiratvavyāyāmair balaṃ vaidyaḥ pratarkayet vyāyāmaiḥ→sthiratvavyāyāmair +balaṃ

tatra mandoṣmatā tvaksavarṇatā śītaśophatā sthairyaṃ mandavedanatālpaśophatā cāmalakṣaṇamuddiṣṭaṃ sūcibhir iva nistudyate daśyata iva pipīlikābhistābhiś ca saṃsarpyata iva chidyata iva śastreṇa bhidyata iva śaktibhistāḍyata iva daṇḍena pīḍyata iva pāṇinā ghaṭyata iva cāṅgulyā dahyate pacyata iva cāgnikṣārābhyām oṣacoṣaparīdāhāś ca bhavanti vṛścikaviddha iva ca sthānāsanaśayaneṣu na śāntim upaiti ādhmātabastirivātataś ca śopho bhavati tvagvaivarṇyaṃ śophābhivṛddhirjvaradāhapipāsā bhaktāruciś ca pacyamānaliṅgaṃ vedanopaśāntiḥ pāṇḍutālpaśophatā valīprādurbhāvastvakparipuṭanaṃ nimnadarśanamaṅgulyāvapīḍite pratyunnamanaṃ bastāvivodakasaṃcaraṇaṃ pūyasya prapīḍayatyekamantamante vāvapīḍite muhurmuhustodaḥ kaṇḍūr unnatatā vyādherupadravaśāntirbhaktābhikāṅkṣā ca pakvaliṅgam ādhmāta+vastiḥ→ādhmātabastirivātataś · śleṣmāsṛgbhyāṃ tālumūlāt pravṛddho dīrghaḥ śopho dhmātabastiprakāśaḥ dhmāta+vasti→dhmātabastiprakāśaḥ · udarorasostu gudabastinābhihṛdayastanamūlastanarohitāpalāpānyapastambhau ceti guda+vasti→gudabastinābhihṛdayastanamūlastanarohitāpalāpānyapastambhau · virekabastivamanānyṛte kuryācca nātyayāt vireka+vasti→virekabastivamanānyṛte

śrūyate hi yathā rudreṇa yajñasya śiraśchinnamiti tato devā aśvināv abhigamyocur bhagavantau naḥ śreṣṭhatamau yuvāṃ bhaviṣyathaḥ bhavadbhyāṃ yajñasya śiraḥ saṃdhātavyam iti śiraḥ+chinnam→śiraśchinnamiti · tābhir daṣṭe puruṣe daṃśe śvayathuratimātraṃ kaṇḍūrmūrchā jvaro dāhaśchardirmadaḥ sadanamiti liṅgāni bhavanti dāhaḥ+chardiḥ→dāhaśchardirmadaḥ · evaṃ vivardhitaḥ karṇaśchidyate tu dvidhā nṛṇām karṇaḥ+chidyate→karṇaśchidyate · svebhyaḥ sthānebhyaḥ śarīraikadeśānām avasrastotkṣiptabhrāntāvakṣiptapatitavimuktanirgatāntargatagurulaghutvāni pravālavarṇavyaṅgaprādurbhāvo vāpyakasmāt sirāṇāṃ ca darśanaṃ lalāṭe nāsāvaṃśe vā piḍakotpattiḥ lalāṭe prabhātakāle svedaḥ netrarogādvinā vāśrupravṛttiḥ gomayacūrṇaprakāśasya vā rajaso darśanamuttamāṅge nilayanaṃ vā kapotakaṅkakākaprabhṛtīnāṃ mūtrapurīṣavṛddhir abhuñjānānāṃ tatpraṇāśo bhuñjānānāṃ vā stanamūlahṛdayoraḥsu ca śūlotpattayaḥ madhye śūnatvamanteṣu parimlāyitvaṃ viparyayo vā tathārdhāṅge śvayathuḥ śoṣo 'ṅgapakṣayor vā naṣṭahīnavikalavikṛtasvaratā vā vivarṇapuṣpaprādurbhāvo vā dantamukhanakhaśarīreṣu yasya vāpsu kaphapurīṣaretāṃsi nimajjanti yasya vā dṛṣṭimaṇḍale bhinnavikṛtāni rūpāṇyālokyante snehābhyaktakeśāṅga iva yo bhāti yaś ca durbalo bhaktadveṣātisārābhyāṃ pīḍyate kāsamānaś ca tṛṣṇābhibhūtaḥ kṣīṇaś chardibhaktadveṣayuktaḥ saphenapūyarudhirodvāmī hatasvaraḥ śūlābhipannaś ca manuṣyaḥ śūnakaracaraṇavadanaḥ kṣīṇo 'nnadveṣī srastapiṇḍikāṃsapāṇipādo jvarakāsābhibhūtaḥ yastu pūrvāhṇe bhuktam aparāhṇe chardayatyavidagdhamatisāryate vā jvarakāsābhibhūtaḥ sa śvāsānmriyate bastavadvilapan yaś ca bhūmau patati srastamuṣkaḥ stabdhameḍhro bhagnagrīvaḥ pranaṣṭamehanaś ca manuṣyaḥ prāgviśuṣyamāṇahṛdaya ārdraśarīraḥ yaś ca loṣṭaṃ loṣṭenābhihanti kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhena tṛṇāni vā chinatti adharoṣṭhaṃ daśati uttaroṣṭhaṃ vā leḍhi āluñcati vā karṇau keśāṃś ca devadvijagurusuhṛdvaidyāṃś ca dveṣṭi yasya vakrānuvakragā grahā garhitasthānagatāḥ pīḍayanti janmarkṣaṃ vā yasyolkāśanibhyāmabhihanyate horā vā gṛhadāraśayanāsanayānavāhanamaṇiratnopakaraṇagarhitalakṣaṇanimittaprādurbhāvo veti kṣīṇaś+chardi

rasāyanatantraṃ nāma vayaḥsthāpanam āyurmedhābalakaraṃ rogāpaharaṇasamarthaṃ ca āyus+medhā→āyurmedhābalakaraṃ · tatrāmlavargaḥ śamanaḥ sarpirmadhukasaṃyutaḥ sarpis+madhuka→sarpirmadhukasaṃyutaḥ · tataḥ śalyamuddhṛtya nirlohitaṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvā svedārham agnighṛtaprabhṛtibhiḥ saṃsvedya vidahya pradihya sarpirmadhubhyāṃ baddhvācārikam upadiśet sarpis+madhubhyām→sarpirmadhubhyāṃ · lihyāt sarpirmadhubhyāṃ ca modakaṃ vā guḍena vā sarpis+madhubhyām→sarpirmadhubhyāṃ

tatra laghvakṣaroccāraṇamātro 'kṣinimeṣaḥ pañcadaśākṣinimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhā triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalā viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ kalādaśabhāgaś ca triṃśanmuhūrtam ahorātraṃ pañcadaśāhorātrāṇi pakṣaḥ sa ca dvividhaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaś ca tau māsaḥ sa+ca · vraṇe śvayathurāyāsāt sa ca rāgaśca jāgarāt sa+ca · tatra āmāśayaḥ pittāśayasyopariṣṭāt tatpratyanīkatvād ūrdhvagatitvāt tejasaścandra iva ādityasya sa caturvidhasyāhārasyādhāraḥ sa ca tatraudakair guṇair āhāraḥ praklinno bhinnasaṃghātaḥ sukhajaraś ca bhavati sa+caturvidhasya · tatra āmāśayaḥ pittāśayasyopariṣṭāt tatpratyanīkatvād ūrdhvagatitvāt tejasaścandra iva ādityasya sa caturvidhasyāhārasyādhāraḥ sa ca tatraudakair guṇair āhāraḥ praklinno bhinnasaṃghātaḥ sukhajaraś ca bhavati sa+ca

tatra sūtrasthānam adhyāyāḥ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśat ṣoḍaśa nidānāni daśa śārīrāṇi catvāriṃśac cikitsitāni aṣṭau kalpāḥ tad uttaraṃ ṣaṭsaṣṭiḥ uttaraṃ+ṣaṭsaṣṭiḥ · śalākāyantrāṇyapi nānāprakārāṇi nānāprayojanāni yathāyogapariṇāhadīrghāṇi ca teṣāṃ gaṇḍūpadasarpaphaṇaśarapuṅkhabaḍiśamukhe dve dve eṣaṇavyūhanacālanāharaṇārtham upadiśyete masūradalamātramukhe dve kiṃcidānatāgre srotogataśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ ṣaṭ kārpāsakṛtoṣṇīṣāṇi pramārjanakriyāsu trīṇi darvyākṛtīni khallamukhāni kṣārauṣadhapraṇidhānārthaṃ trīṇyanyāni jāmbavavadanāni trīṇyaṅkuśavadanāni ṣaḍevāgnikarmasvabhipretāni nāsārbudaharaṇārthamekaṃ kolāsthidalamātramukhaṃ khallatīkṣṇauṣṭham añjanārthamekaṃ kalāyaparimaṇḍalam ubhayato mukulāgraṃ mūtramārgaviśodhanārtham ekaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛntāgrapramāṇaparimaṇḍalam iti artham→srotogataśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ +ṣaṭ · ata ūrdhvam eteṣāmavadīrṇānāṃ vraṇabhāvam āpannānāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kriyākālaḥ jvarātisāraprabhṛtīnāṃ ca dīrghakālānubandhaḥ āpannānāṃ+ṣaṣṭhaḥ · tatra svair aṅgulaiḥ pādāṅguṣṭhapradeśinyau dvyaṅgulāyate pradeśinyāstu madhyamānāmikākaniṣṭhikā yathottaraṃ pañcamabhāgahīnāḥ caturaṅgulāyate pañcāṅgulavistṛte prapadapādatale pañcacaturaṅgulāyatavistṛtā pārṣṇiḥ caturdaśāṅgulāyataḥ pādaḥ caturdaśāṅgulapariṇāhāni pādagulphajaṅghājānumadhyāni aṣṭādaśāṅgulā jaṅghā jānūpariṣṭāc ca dvātriṃśadaṅgulamevaṃ pañcāśat jaṅghāyāmasamāvūrū dvyaṅgulāni vṛṣaṇacibukadaśananāsāpuṭabhāgakarṇamūlanayanāntarāṇi caturaṅgulāni mehanavadanāntaranāsākarṇalalāṭagrīvocchrāyadṛṣṭyantarāṇi dvādaśāṅgulāni bhagavistāramehananābhihṛdayagrīvāstanāntaramukhāyāmamaṇibandhaprakoṣṭhasthaulyāni indravastipariṇāhāṃsapīṭhakūrparāntarāyāmaḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulaḥ caturviṃśatyaṅgulo hastaḥ dvātriṃśadaṅgulaparimāṇau bhujau dvātriṃśatpariṇāhāvūrū maṇibandhakūrparāntaraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulaṃ talaṃ ṣaṭcaturaṅgulāyāmavistāram aṅguṣṭhamūlapradeśinīśravaṇāpāṅgāntaramadhyamāṅgulyau pañcāṅgule ardhapañcāṅgule pradeśinyanāmike sārdhatryaṅgulau kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhau caturviṃśativistārapariṇāhaṃ mukhagrīvaṃ tribhāgāṅgulavistārā nāsāpuṭamaryādā nayanatribhāgapariṇāhā tārakā navamastārakāṃśo dṛṣṭiḥ keśāntamastakāntaramekādaśāṅgulaṃ mastakādavaṭukeśānto daśāṅgulaḥ karṇāvaṭvantaraṃ caturdaśāṅgulaṃ puruṣoraḥpramāṇavistīrṇā strīśroṇiḥ aṣṭādaśāṅgulavistāramuraḥ tatpramāṇā puruṣasya kaṭī saviṃśamaṅgulaśataṃ puruṣāyāma iti talaṃ+ṣaṣ

tataḥ śastram avacārya śītābhir adbhir āturam āśvāsya samantāt paripīḍyāṅgulyā vraṇam abhimṛdya prakṣālya kaṣāyeṇa protenodakamādāya tilakalkamadhusarpiḥpragāḍhām auṣadhayuktāṃ nātisnigdhāṃ nātirūkṣāṃ vartiṃ praṇidadhyāt tataḥ kalkenācchādya ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ dattvā vastrapaṭṭena badhnīyāt vedanārakṣoghnair dhūpair dhūpayet rakṣoghnaiś ca mantrai rakṣāṃ kurvīta dhūpair+dhūpayet · tataḥ śastram avacārya śītābhir adbhir āturam āśvāsya samantāt paripīḍyāṅgulyā vraṇam abhimṛdya prakṣālya kaṣāyeṇa protenodakamādāya tilakalkamadhusarpiḥpragāḍhām auṣadhayuktāṃ nātisnigdhāṃ nātirūkṣāṃ vartiṃ praṇidadhyāt tataḥ kalkenācchādya ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ dattvā vastrapaṭṭena badhnīyāt vedanārakṣoghnair dhūpair dhūpayet rakṣoghnaiś ca mantrai rakṣāṃ kurvīta ghnaiḥ→vedanārakṣoghnair +dhūpair · tato guggulvagurusarjarasavacāgaurasarṣapacūrṇair lavaṇanimbapattravimiśrair ājyayuktair dhūpayet ājyaśeṣeṇa cāsya prāṇān samālabheta yuktaiḥ→ājyayuktair +dhūpayet · pratyutpannamatir dhīmān vyavasāyī viśāradaḥ matiḥ→pratyutpannamatir +dhīmān

rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedaḥ prajāyate tato+māṃsaṃ · medaso 'sthi tato majjā majjñaḥ śukraṃ tu jāyate tato+majjā · tato madhughṛtenābhyajya picuplotayor anyatareṇāvaguṇṭhya sūtreṇānavagāḍham anatiśithilaṃ ca baddhvā kapālacūrṇenāvakīryācārikam upadiśeddvivraṇīyoktena ca vidhānenopacaret tato+madhu · ato mānaviruddhān vakṣyāmaḥ madhvambunī madhusarpiṣī mānatastulye nāśnīyāt snehau madhusnehau jalasnehau vā viśeṣād āntarīkṣodakānupānau ato+māna

śrūyate hi yathā rudreṇa yajñasya śiraśchinnamiti tato devā aśvināv abhigamyocur bhagavantau naḥ śreṣṭhatamau yuvāṃ bhaviṣyathaḥ bhavadbhyāṃ yajñasya śiraḥ saṃdhātavyam iti tato+devā · tato dūtanimittaśakunamaṅgalānulomyenāturagṛhamabhigamya upaviśya āturamabhipaśyet spṛśet pṛcchec ca tribhir etair vijñānopāyai rogāḥ prāyaśo veditavyā ity eke tattu na samyak ṣaḍvidho hi rogāṇāṃ vijñānopāyaḥ tadyathā pañcabhiḥ śrotrādibhiḥ praśnena ceti tato+dūta · yathā mahānudakasaṃcayo 'tivṛddhaḥ setum avadāryāpareṇodakena vyāmiśraḥ sarvataḥ pradhāvati evaṃ doṣāḥ kadācidekaśo dviśaḥ samastāḥ śoṇitasahitā vānekadhā prasaranti ekaśas→kadācidekaśo +dviśaḥ · eṣaṇyā sarvato dṛṣṭvā yathāmārgaṃ cikitsakaḥ sarvato+dṛṣṭvā

doṣasthānānyata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ tatra samāsena vātaḥ śroṇigudasaṃśrayaḥ taduparyadho nābheḥ pakvāśayaḥ pakvāmāśayamadhyaṃ pittasya āmāśayaḥ śleṣmaṇaḥ adhas→taduparyadho +nābheḥ · prāyo nirbhujyate śārṅgamāyasaṃ ceti niścayaḥ prāyo+nirbhujyate · jīvatyadho niḥsruteṣu sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvati adhas→jīvatyadho +niḥsruteṣu · chinneṣu pāṇicaraṇeṣu sirā narāṇāṃ saṃkocam īyurasṛgalpamato nireti atas→īyurasṛgalpamato +nireti

tasmād antarbahiś caiva suśuddhaṃ ropayed vraṇam bahis→antarbahiś +ca · tair evāvyāpannair adhomadhyordhvasaṃniviṣṭaiḥ śarīramidaṃ dhāryate 'gāram iva sthūṇābhis tisṛbhir ataś ca tristhūṇamāhureke ataś+ca · asthivivarapraviṣṭamasthividaṣṭaṃ vāvagṛhya pādābhyāṃ yantreṇāpaharet aśakyamevaṃ vā balavadbhiḥ suparigṛhītasya yantreṇa grāhayitvā śalyavāraṅgaṃ pravibhujya dhanurguṇair baddhvaikataś cāsya pañcāṅgyām upasaṃyatasyāśvasya vaktrakavike badhnīyāt athainaṃ kaśayā tāḍayedyathonnamayan śiro vegena śalyamuddharati dṛḍhāṃ vā vṛkṣaśākhāmavanamya tasyāṃ pūrvavadbaddhvoddharet ekatas→baddhvaikataś +ca · kṛtavedhanaphalapippalīnāṃ vamanadravyakaṣāyaparipītānāṃ bahuśaścūrṇamutpalādiṣu dattamāghrātaṃ vāmayati tattvanavabaddhadoṣeṣu yavāgūm ā kaṇṭhāt pītavatsu ca vidadhyāt bahuśas+cūrṇam→bahuśaścūrṇamutpalādiṣu

sa sūkṣmām api kalāṃ na līyata iti kālaḥ saṃkalayati kālayati vā bhūtānīti kālaḥ sa+sūkṣmām · tatra varṣāsvoṣadhayastaruṇyo 'lpavīryā āpaś cāprasannāḥ kṣitimalaprāyāḥ tā upayujyamānā nabhasi meghāvatate jalapraklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātaviṣṭambhitāgnīnāṃ vidahyante vidāhāt pittasaṃcayamāpādayanti sa saṃcayaḥ śaradi praviralameghe viyaty upaśuṣyati paṅke 'rkakiraṇapravilāyitaḥ paittikān vyādhīn janayati sa+saṃcayaḥ · tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaś ca prasannāḥ snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyaś ca tā upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvādbhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ dehināmavidagdhāḥ snehācchaityādgauravād upalepāc ca śleṣmasaṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayo vasante 'rkaraśmipravilāyita īṣatstabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīn janayati sa+saṃcayo · tā evauṣadhayo nidāghe niḥsārā rūkṣā atimātraṃ laghvyo bhavantyāpaś ca tā upayujyamānāḥ sūryapratāpopaśoṣitadehānāṃ dehināṃ raukṣyāllaghutvādvaiśadyāc ca vāyoḥ saṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayaḥ prāvṛṣi cātyarthaṃ jalopaklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātavarṣerito vātikān vyādhīn janayati sa+saṃcayaḥ

sa sūkṣmām api kalāṃ na līyata iti kālaḥ saṃkalayati kālayati vā bhūtānīti kālaḥ līyata+iti · atha khalvayane dve yugapat saṃvatsaro bhavati te tu pañca yugamiti saṃjñāṃ labhante sa eṣa nimeṣādiryugaparyantaḥ kālaścakravat parivartamānaḥ kālacakram ucyata ity eke ucyata+ity · daṃśe todakaṇḍuprādurbhāvair jānīyācchuddhamiyamādatta iti śuddhamādadānāmapanayet atha śoṇitagandhena na muñcenmukhamasyāḥ saindhavacūrṇenāvakiret ādatte→jānīyācchuddhamiyamādatta +iti · tatra mandoṣmatā tvaksavarṇatā śītaśophatā sthairyaṃ mandavedanatālpaśophatā cāmalakṣaṇamuddiṣṭaṃ sūcibhir iva nistudyate daśyata iva pipīlikābhistābhiś ca saṃsarpyata iva chidyata iva śastreṇa bhidyata iva śaktibhistāḍyata iva daṇḍena pīḍyata iva pāṇinā ghaṭyata iva cāṅgulyā dahyate pacyata iva cāgnikṣārābhyām oṣacoṣaparīdāhāś ca bhavanti vṛścikaviddha iva ca sthānāsanaśayaneṣu na śāntim upaiti ādhmātabastirivātataś ca śopho bhavati tvagvaivarṇyaṃ śophābhivṛddhirjvaradāhapipāsā bhaktāruciś ca pacyamānaliṅgaṃ vedanopaśāntiḥ pāṇḍutālpaśophatā valīprādurbhāvastvakparipuṭanaṃ nimnadarśanamaṅgulyāvapīḍite pratyunnamanaṃ bastāvivodakasaṃcaraṇaṃ pūyasya prapīḍayatyekamantamante vāvapīḍite muhurmuhustodaḥ kaṇḍūr unnatatā vyādherupadravaśāntirbhaktābhikāṅkṣā ca pakvaliṅgam daśyata+iva

ādhmānamiti jānīyādghoraṃ vātanirodhajam jānīyāt+ghoram→jānīyādghoraṃ · tāmādiśet pavanapittakaphaprakopād ghorām asukṣayakarīm iva kālarātrim prakopāt→pavanapittakaphaprakopād +ghorām · kaphādghanaṃ picchilaṃ ca jale cāpyavasīdati kaphāt+ghanam→kaphādghanaṃ · dattvā tato nibadhnīyāt saptāhaṃ ca pibedghṛtam pibet+ghṛtam→pibedghṛtam

yato yato gatiṃ vidyād utsaṅgo yatra yatra ca yato+yato · ato yo viparītaḥ syāt sukhasādhyaḥ sa ucyate ato+yo · ghaṭṭate bahuśo yatra śūyate tudyate 'pi ca bahuśo+yatra · kṣuṇṇāṃstasmiṃstu niḥkvāthe bhāvayedbahuśo yavān bahuśas→bhāvayedbahuśo +yavān

sa trividhaḥ pralepaḥ pradeha ālepaś ca sa+trividhaḥ · sa tatrastha eva svaśaktyā śeṣāṇāṃ śleṣmasthānānāṃ śarīrasya codakakarmaṇānugrahaṃ karoti uraḥsthas trikasaṃdhāraṇam ātmavīryeṇānnarasasahitena hṛdayāvalambanaṃ karoti jihvāmūlakaṇṭhastho jihvendriyasya saumyatvāt samyagrasajñāne vartate śiraḥsthaḥ snehasaṃtarpaṇādhikṛtatvād indriyāṇām ātmavīryeṇānugrahaṃ karoti saṃdhisthastu śleṣmā sarvasaṃdhisaṃśleṣāt sarvasaṃdhyanugrahaṃ karoti sa+tatrastha · te yadodarasaṃniveśaṃ kurvanti tadā gulmavidradhyudarāgnisaṅgānāhaviṣūcikātisāraprabhṛtīn janayanti vastigatāḥ pramehāśmarīmūtrāghātamūtradoṣaprabhṛtīn vṛṣaṇagatā vṛddhīḥ meḍhragatā niruddhaprakaśopadaṃśaśūkadoṣaprabhṛtīn gudagatā bhagaṃdarārśaḥprabhṛtīn ūrdhvajatrugatās tūrdhvajān tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitasthāḥ kṣudrarogān kuṣṭhāni visarpāṃś ca medogatā granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍālajīprabhṛtīn asthigatā vidradhyanuśayīprabhṛtīn pādagatāḥ ślīpadavātaśoṇitavātakaṇṭakaprabhṛtīn sarvāṅgagatā jvarasarvāṅgarogaprabhṛtīn teṣāmevamabhiniviṣṭānāṃ pūrvarūpaprādurbhāvaḥ taṃ pratirogaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ gatāḥ→sarvāṅgagatā +teṣām · tatra aupasargiko yaḥ pūrvotpannaṃ vyādhiṃ jaghanyakālajāto vyādhirupasṛjati sa tanmūla evopadravasaṃjñaḥ prākkevalo yaḥ prāgevotpanno vyādhirapūrvarūpo 'nupadravaś ca anyalakṣaṇo yo bhaviṣyadvyādhikhyāpakaḥ sa pūrvarūpasaṃjñaḥ sa+tad

tatrāgnikarma sarvartuṣu kuryādanyatra śaradgrīṣmābhyāṃ tatrāpyātyayike 'gnikarmasādhye vyādhau tatpratyanīkaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā sarva+ṛtuṣu→sarvartuṣu · narte dehaḥ kaphādasti na pittānna ca mārutāt na+ṛte→narte · kālabalapravṛttā ye śītoṣṇavātavarṣāprabhṛtinimittāḥ te 'pi dvividhāḥ vyāpannartukṛtā avyāpannartukṛtāś ca vyāpanna+ṛtu→vyāpannartukṛtā · svebhyaḥ sthānebhyaḥ śarīraikadeśānām avasrastotkṣiptabhrāntāvakṣiptapatitavimuktanirgatāntargatagurulaghutvāni pravālavarṇavyaṅgaprādurbhāvo vāpyakasmāt sirāṇāṃ ca darśanaṃ lalāṭe nāsāvaṃśe vā piḍakotpattiḥ lalāṭe prabhātakāle svedaḥ netrarogādvinā vāśrupravṛttiḥ gomayacūrṇaprakāśasya vā rajaso darśanamuttamāṅge nilayanaṃ vā kapotakaṅkakākaprabhṛtīnāṃ mūtrapurīṣavṛddhir abhuñjānānāṃ tatpraṇāśo bhuñjānānāṃ vā stanamūlahṛdayoraḥsu ca śūlotpattayaḥ madhye śūnatvamanteṣu parimlāyitvaṃ viparyayo vā tathārdhāṅge śvayathuḥ śoṣo 'ṅgapakṣayor vā naṣṭahīnavikalavikṛtasvaratā vā vivarṇapuṣpaprādurbhāvo vā dantamukhanakhaśarīreṣu yasya vāpsu kaphapurīṣaretāṃsi nimajjanti yasya vā dṛṣṭimaṇḍale bhinnavikṛtāni rūpāṇyālokyante snehābhyaktakeśāṅga iva yo bhāti yaś ca durbalo bhaktadveṣātisārābhyāṃ pīḍyate kāsamānaś ca tṛṣṇābhibhūtaḥ kṣīṇaś chardibhaktadveṣayuktaḥ saphenapūyarudhirodvāmī hatasvaraḥ śūlābhipannaś ca manuṣyaḥ śūnakaracaraṇavadanaḥ kṣīṇo 'nnadveṣī srastapiṇḍikāṃsapāṇipādo jvarakāsābhibhūtaḥ yastu pūrvāhṇe bhuktam aparāhṇe chardayatyavidagdhamatisāryate vā jvarakāsābhibhūtaḥ sa śvāsānmriyate bastavadvilapan yaś ca bhūmau patati srastamuṣkaḥ stabdhameḍhro bhagnagrīvaḥ pranaṣṭamehanaś ca manuṣyaḥ prāgviśuṣyamāṇahṛdaya ārdraśarīraḥ yaś ca loṣṭaṃ loṣṭenābhihanti kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhena tṛṇāni vā chinatti adharoṣṭhaṃ daśati uttaroṣṭhaṃ vā leḍhi āluñcati vā karṇau keśāṃś ca devadvijagurusuhṛdvaidyāṃś ca dveṣṭi yasya vakrānuvakragā grahā garhitasthānagatāḥ pīḍayanti janmarkṣaṃ vā yasyolkāśanibhyāmabhihanyate horā vā gṛhadāraśayanāsanayānavāhanamaṇiratnopakaraṇagarhitalakṣaṇanimittaprādurbhāvo veti janma+ṛkṣam→janmarkṣaṃ

vāmācārā rudantaś ca śvāsino vikṛtekṣaṇāḥ vikṛta+īkṣaṇāḥ→vikṛtekṣaṇāḥ · lohitaṃ chardayedyastu bahuśo lohitekṣaṇaḥ lohita+īkṣaṇaḥ→lohitekṣaṇaḥ · cale doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe nekṣetātra balaṃ nṛṇām na+īkṣeta→nekṣetātra · bhuktamātre kaphaścāpi tasmād bhukteritaṃ kapham bhukta+īritam→bhukteritaṃ

athāto vedotpattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +vedotpattim · athāto viśikhānupraveśanīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +viśikhānupraveśanīyam · athāto vraṇālepanabandhavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +vraṇālepanabandhavidhim · athāto vraṇitopāsanīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +vraṇitopāsanīyam

ahaṃ vā tvayi samyagvartamāne yadyanyathādarśī syām enobhāg bhaveyam aphalavidyaś ca samyak+vartamāne→samyagvartamāne · atha patitāṃ taṇḍulakaṇḍanapradigdhagātrīṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktamukhīṃ vāmahastāṅguṣṭhāṅgulībhyāṃ gṛhītapucchāṃ dakṣiṇahastāṅguṣṭhāṅgulibhyāṃ śanaiḥ śanair anulomam anumārjayed ā mukhāt vāmayet tāvadyāvat samyagvāntaliṅgānīti samyak+vānta→samyagvāntaliṅgānīti · samyagvāntā salilasarakanyastā bhoktukāmā satī caret samyak+vāntā→samyagvāntā · yā sīdatī na ceṣṭate sā durvāntā tāṃ punaḥ samyagvāmayet samyak+vāmayet→samyagvāmayet

tata eva kṣārodakāt kuḍavamadhyardhaṃ vāpanayet tata+eva · kriyāyāṃ tu nivṛttāyāṃ sadya eva vinaśyati sadya+eva · jijīviṣurdūrata eva vaidyaṃ vivarjayedugraviṣāhitulyam dūratas→jijīviṣurdūrata +eva · saindhavopahitāṃ sadya eṣa yogo virecayet sadya+eṣa

tilakalkaḥ samadhuko ghṛtākto vraṇaropaṇaḥ samadhuko+ghṛta · ata ūrdhvaṃ sarvasrāvān vakṣyāmaḥ tatra ghṛṣṭāsu chinnāsu vā tvakṣu sphoṭe bhinne vidārite vā salilaprakāśo bhavatyāsrāvaḥ kiṃcidvisraḥ pītāvabhāsaś ca māṃsagataḥ sadyaśchinnāsu sirāsu raktātipravṛttiḥ pakvāsu ca toyanāḍībhir iva toyāgamanaṃ pūyasya āsrāvaś cātra tanurvicchinnaḥ picchilo 'valambī śyāvo 'vaśyāyapratimaś ca snāyugataḥ snigdho ghanaḥ siṅghāṇakapratimaḥ saraktaś ca asthigato 'sthanyabhihate sphuṭite bhinne doṣāvadārite vā doṣabhakṣitatvādasthi niḥsāraṃ śuktidhautam ivābhāti āsrāvaś cātra majjamiśraḥ sarudhiraḥ snigdhaśca saṃdhigataḥ pīḍyamāno na pravartate ākuñcanaprasāraṇonnamanavinamanapradhāvanotkāsanapravāhaṇaiś ca sravati āsrāvaś cātra picchilo 'valambī saphenapūyarudhironmathitaś ca koṣṭhagato 'sṛṅmūtrapurīṣapūyodakāni sravati marmagatastvagādiṣvavaruddhatvānnocyate snigdho+ghanaḥ · hṛdyāḥ sugandhino bhakṣyā laghavo ghṛtapācitāḥ laghavo+ghṛta · nānāvarṇarujāsrāvo ghāṭālo viṣamo mahān āsrāvaḥ→nānāvarṇarujāsrāvo +ghāṭālo

evaṃ cenmanyase vatsa procyamānaṃ nibodha me ced+manyase→cenmanyase · tatra tvakpranaṣṭe snigdhasvinnāyāṃ mṛnmāṣayavagodhūmagomayamṛditāyāṃ tvaci yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt styānaghṛtamṛccandanakalkair vā pradigdhāyāṃ śalyoṣmaṇāśu visarati ghṛtam upaśuṣyati vā lepo yatra tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt māṃsapranaṣṭe snehasvedādibhiḥ kriyāviśeṣair aviruddhair āturam upapādayet karśitasya tu śithilībhūtam anavabaddhaṃ kṣubhyamāṇaṃ yatra saṃrambhaṃ vedanāṃ vā janayati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt koṣṭhāsthisandhipeśīvivareṣvavasthitam evam eva parīkṣeta sirādhamanīsrotaḥsnāyupranaṣṭe khaṇḍacakrasaṃyukte yāne vyādhitamāropyāśu viṣame 'dhvani yāyādyatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ jānīyāt asthipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannānyasthīni bandhanapīḍanābhyāṃ bhṛśam upācaredyatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ jānīyāt sandhipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannān sandhīn prasaraṇākuñcanabandhanapīḍanair bhṛśam upācaret yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt marmapranaṣṭe tv ananyabhāvān marmaṇām uktaṃ parīkṣaṇaṃ bhavati mṛd+māṣa→mṛnmāṣayavagodhūmagomayamṛditāyāṃ · śalyāni na viśīryante śarīre mṛnmayāni ca mṛd+mayāni→mṛnmayāni · tatra aupasargiko yaḥ pūrvotpannaṃ vyādhiṃ jaghanyakālajāto vyādhirupasṛjati sa tanmūla evopadravasaṃjñaḥ prākkevalo yaḥ prāgevotpanno vyādhirapūrvarūpo 'nupadravaś ca anyalakṣaṇo yo bhaviṣyadvyādhikhyāpakaḥ sa pūrvarūpasaṃjñaḥ tad+mūlaḥ→tanmūla

tā evauṣadhayo nidāghe niḥsārā rūkṣā atimātraṃ laghvyo bhavantyāpaś ca tā upayujyamānāḥ sūryapratāpopaśoṣitadehānāṃ dehināṃ raukṣyāllaghutvādvaiśadyāc ca vāyoḥ saṃcayam āpādayanti sa saṃcayaḥ prāvṛṣi cātyarthaṃ jalopaklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātavarṣerito vātikān vyādhīn janayati raukṣyāt+laghu→raukṣyāllaghutvādvaiśadyāc · tatra śaityaraukṣyalāghavavaiśadyavaiṣṭambhyaguṇalakṣaṇo vāyuḥ tasya samānayoniḥ kaṣāyo rasaḥ so 'sya śaityācchaityaṃ vardhayati raukṣyādraukṣyaṃ lāghavāllāghavaṃ vaiśadyādvaiśadyaṃ vaiṣṭambhyādvaiṣṭambhyam iti lāghavāt+lāghavam→lāghavāllāghavaṃ · auṣṇyataikṣṇyaraukṣyalāghavavaiśadyaguṇalakṣaṇaṃ pittaṃ tasya samānayoniḥ kaṭuko rasaḥ so 'syauṣṇyādauṣṇyaṃ vardhayati taikṣṇyāttaikṣṇyaṃ raukṣyādraukṣyaṃ lāghavāllāghavaṃ vaiśadyādvaiśadyam iti lāghavāt+lāghavam→lāghavāllāghavaṃ · pacellehaṃ sitākṣaudrapalārdhakuḍavānvitam pacet+leham→pacellehaṃ

vamataḥ koṣṭhaśuddhiḥ syād dhūmagandhaś ca naśyati syād+dhūma · ta ete śarīradhāraṇād dhātava ity ucyante dhāraṇāt→śarīradhāraṇād +dhātava · dvirahnaḥ kārayeddhūpaṃ daśarātram atandritaḥ kārayet+dhūpam→kārayeddhūpaṃ · udakapūrṇodaram avākśirasam avapīḍayed dhunīyād vāmayedvā bhasmarāśau vā nikhaned ā mukhāt avapīḍayed+dhunīyād

sa uvācaivam astv iti astv+iti · sa hovācaivam astv iti astv+iti · tāv ūcatur evam astv iti astv+iti · brahmā provāca tataḥ prajāpatir adhijage tasmād aśvinau aśvibhyām indraḥ indrād ahaṃ mayā tv iha pradeyam arthibhyaḥ prajāhitahetoḥ tv+iha

athāto 'dhyayanasaṃpradānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +'dhyayanasaṃpradānīyam · athāto 'gropaharaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +agropaharaṇīyam · athāto 'gnikarmavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +'gnikarmavidhim · athāto 'ṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atas→athāto +'ṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyam

śītāmuṣṇāṃ ca durdagdhe kriyāṃ kuryādbhiṣak punaḥ bhiṣaj→kuryādbhiṣak +punaḥ · kriyāṃ kuryādbhiṣak paścācchālitaṇḍulakaṇḍanaiḥ bhiṣaj→kuryādbhiṣak +paścāt · kriyāṃ ca nikhilāṃ kuryād bhiṣak pittavisarpavat bhiṣak+pitta · varjayettān bhiṣak prājñaḥ saṃrakṣannātmano yaśaḥ bhiṣak+prājñaḥ

evam etat puruṣo vyādhir auṣadhaṃ kriyākāla iti catuṣṭayaṃ samāsena vyākhyātam tatra puruṣagrahaṇāt tatsambhavadravyasamūho bhūtādir uktas tadaṅgapratyaṅgavikalpāś ca tvaṅmāṃsāsthisirāsnāyuprabhṛtayaḥ vyādhigrahaṇād vātapittakaphaśoṇitasaṃnipātavaiṣamyanimittāḥ sarva eva vyādhayo vyākhyātāḥ oṣadhagrahaṇād dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākānām ādeśaḥ kriyāgrahaṇācchedyādīni snehādīni ca karmāṇi vyākhyātāni kālagrahaṇāt sarvakriyākālānām ādeśaḥ tvac+māṃsa→tvaṅmāṃsāsthisirāsnāyuprabhṛtayaḥ · tataḥ praśasteṣu tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatreṣu dadhyakṣatānnapānaratnair agniṃ viprān bhiṣajaś cārcayitvā kṛtabalimaṅgalasvastivācanaṃ laghubhuktavantaṃ prāṅmukham āturam upaveśya yantrayitvā pratyaṅmukho vaidyo marmasirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthidhamanīḥ pariharan anulomaṃ śastraṃ nidadhyād ā pūyadarśanāt sakṛd evāpaharec chastram āśu ca mahatsv api ca pākeṣu dvyaṅgulāntaraṃ tryaṅgulāntaraṃ vā śastrapadamuktam prāc+mukham→prāṅmukham · sanigraho 'nigrahaś ca saṃdaṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulau bhavatas tau tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyugataśalyoddharaṇārtham upadiśyete tvac+māṃsa→tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyugataśalyoddharaṇārtham · tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthisthite 'tyugraruji vāyāvucchritakaṭhinasuptamāṃse vraṇe granthyarśo'rbudabhagaṃdarāpacīślīpadacarmakīlatilakālakāntravṛddhisaṃdhisirāchedanādiṣu nāḍīśoṇitātipravṛttiṣu cāgnikarma kuryāt tvac+māṃsa→tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusaṃdhyasthisthite

kṛṣṇe 'ṣṭamī tannidhane 'hanī dve śukle tathāpy evam ahar dvisaṃdhyam tad+nidhane→tannidhane · atrocyate doṣān pratyākhyāya jvarādayo na bhavanti atha ca na nityaḥ sambandhaḥ yathāhi vidyudvātāśanivarṣāṇyākāśaṃ pratyākhyāya na bhavanti satyapyākāśe kadācin na bhavanti atha ca nimittatastata evotpattiriti taraṃgabudbudādayaś codakaviśeṣāḥ eva vātādīnāṃ jvarādīnāṃ ca nāpyevam saṃśleṣo na paricchedaḥ śāśvatikaḥ atha ca nimittata evotpattir iti kadācin+na · tatra mārutāt pariśuṣkāruṇavivarṇāni viṣamamadhyāni kadambapuṣpatuṇḍikerīnāḍīmukulasūcīmukhākṛtīni ca bhavanti tair upadrutaḥ saśūlaṃ saṃhatam upaveśyate kaṭīpṛṣṭhapārśvameḍhragudanābhipradeśeṣu cāsya vedanā bhavanti gulmāṣṭhīlāplīhodarāṇi cāsya tannimittānyeva bhavanti kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhanayanadaśanavadanamūtrapurīṣaś ca puruṣo bhavati tad+nimittāni→tannimittānyeva · śleṣmajāni śvetāni mahāmūlāni sthirāṇi vṛttāni snigdhāni pāṇḍūni karīrapanasāsthigostanākārāṇi na bhidyante na sravanti kaṇḍūbahulāni ca bhavanti tair upadrutaḥ saśleṣmāṇam analpaṃ māṃsadhāvanaprakāśamatisāryate śophaśītajvarārocakāvipākaśirogauravāṇi cāsya tannimittānyeva bhavanti śuklatvaṅnakhanayanadaśanavadanamūtrapurīṣaś ca puruṣo bhavati tad+nimittāni→tannimittānyeva
